title: Pomáhame spolu

sentences.sk: V sobotu ráno prišla Maja do komunitného centra.
sentences.en: On Saturday morning Maja came to the community centre.

sentences.sk: Johanna: Ahoj! Kde sú ostatní dobrovoľníci?
sentences.en: Johanna: Hi! Where are the other volunteers?

sentences.sk: Maja: Neviem. Ešte tu nikto nebol okrem nás.
sentences.en: Maja: I don't know. Nobody was here yet except us.

sentences.sk: Hovorili o charitatívnej akcii celý týždeň.
sentences.en: They had been talking about the charity event all week.

sentences.sk: Johanna: Dnes v stredu sme mali prísť o deviatej.
sentences.en: Johanna: Today on Wednesday we were supposed to come at nine.

sentences.sk: Maja: Ale dnes je sobota, nie streda!
sentences.en: Maja: But today is Saturday, not Wednesday!

sentences.sk: Johanna sa pozrela na telefón a začervenala sa.
sentences.en: Johanna looked at her phone and blushed.

sentences.sk: Johanna: Máš pravdu. Prepáč, pomýlila som sa.
sentences.en: Johanna: You are right. Sorry, I made a mistake.

sentences.sk: Zrazu prišli ďalší ľudia s taškami plnými jedla.
sentences.en: Suddenly more people arrived with bags full of food.

sentences.sk: Maja: Výborne! Teraz nám nič nechýba.
sentences.en: Maja: Excellent! Now we are not missing anything.

sentences.sk: Rozprávali sa o ťažkých životoch chudobných rodín.
sentences.en: They talked about the difficult lives of poor families.

sentences.sk: Johanna nosila krabice a Maja varila polievku.
sentences.en: Johanna carried boxes and Maja cooked soup.

sentences.sk: O jednej poobede prišlo veľa ľudí po jedlo.
sentences.en: At one o'clock in the afternoon many people came for food.

sentences.sk: Nikto neodišiel domov hladný.
sentences.en: Nobody went home hungry.

sentences.sk: Maja: Táto sobota bola najlepší deň v roku!
sentences.en: Maja: This Saturday was the best day of the year!

grammarFocus: Locative with 'o': sentences 4 (o charitatívnej akcii), 11 (o ťažkých životoch) — o + locative for topic; Double negation: sentence 3 (nikto nebol), sentence 10 (nič nechýba), sentence 14 (nikto neodišiel); Weekday + time: sentence 5 (v stredu o deviatej), sentence 6 (dnes je sobota), sentence 13 (o jednej poobede), sentence 15 (táto sobota)

title: Chýba soľ!

sentences.sk: Carlo varil večeru v kuchyni.
sentences.en: Carlo was cooking dinner in the kitchen.

sentences.sk: Robil cestoviny s paradajkovou omáčkou.
sentences.en: He was making pasta with tomato sauce.

sentences.sk: Zrazu si všimol, že chýba soľ.
sentences.en: Suddenly he noticed that the salt was missing.

sentences.sk: Carlo: Róbert, máme doma soľ?
sentences.en: Carlo: Róbert, do we have salt at home?

sentences.sk: Róbert: Nie, minuli sme ju včera.
sentences.en: Róbert: No, we used it up yesterday.

sentences.sk: Carlo išiel do obchodu autobusom.
sentences.en: Carlo went to the shop by bus.

sentences.sk: Ale obchod bol zatvorený.
sentences.en: But the shop was closed.

sentences.sk: Carlo sa vrátil domov za Róbertom.
sentences.en: Carlo came back home after Róbert.

sentences.sk: Carlo: Obchod bol zatvorený, čo teraz?
sentences.en: Carlo: The shop was closed, what now?

sentences.sk: Róbert: Poďme do reštaurácie vedľa nás.
sentences.en: Róbert: Let's go to the restaurant next to us.

sentences.sk: Prišli do talianskej reštaurácie pešo.
sentences.en: They came to the Italian restaurant on foot.

sentences.sk: Carlo: Dám si cestoviny s parmezánom.
sentences.en: Carlo: I'll have pasta with parmesan.

sentences.sk: Róbert: Dám si pizzu so šunkou.
sentences.en: Róbert: I'll have pizza with ham.

sentences.sk: Jedlo bolo výborne ochutené.
sentences.en: The food was excellently seasoned.

sentences.sk: Carlo sa smial: Soľ tu nechýba!
sentences.en: Carlo laughed: The salt is not missing here!

grammarFocus: Instrumental bare (transport): 'autobusom' (sentence 6), 'pešo' (sentence 11); Instrumental preposition 'za': 'za Róbertom' = after/to find Róbert (sentence 8); Restaurant ordering 'Dám si...': sentences 12 and 13.

title: Kde sú kľúče?

sentences.sk: Carlo išiel domov o siedmej večer.
sentences.en: Carlo went home at seven in the evening.

sentences.sk: Pred dverami si siahol do vrecka.
sentences.en: In front of the door he reached into his pocket.

sentences.sk: Kľúče tam neboli.
sentences.en: The keys were not there.

sentences.sk: Carlo: Nie! Kde sú moje kľúče?
sentences.en: Carlo: No! Where are my keys?

sentences.sk: Zavolal svojmu susedovi Róbertovi.
sentences.en: He called his neighbour Róbert.

sentences.sk: Carlo: Róbert, už si doma?
sentences.en: Carlo: Róbert, are you home already?

sentences.sk: Róbert: Nie, ešte som nešiel domov.
sentences.en: Róbert: No, I haven't gone home yet.

sentences.sk: Róbert: O koľkej si prišiel k dverám?
sentences.en: Róbert: At what time did you get to the door?

sentences.sk: Carlo: Prišiel som o siedmej, ale kľúče nemám.
sentences.en: Carlo: I arrived at seven, but I don't have the keys.

sentences.sk: Róbert prišiel domov o ôsmej.
sentences.en: Róbert came home at eight.

sentences.sk: Róbert: Čakaj, mám náhradný kľúč!
sentences.en: Róbert: Wait, I have a spare key!

sentences.sk: Carlo: Naozaj? To je skvelé!
sentences.en: Carlo: Really? That is great!

sentences.sk: Róbert otvoril dvere náhradným kľúčom.
sentences.en: Róbert opened the door with the spare key.

sentences.sk: Carlo už bol vo svojom byte.
sentences.en: Carlo was already in his apartment.

sentences.sk: Svoje kľúče našiel na stole.
sentences.en: He found his keys on the table.

grammarFocus: Past tense irregular ísť→išiel: sentences 1 (Carlo išiel), 7 (nešiel — negated past with ešte+past), 10 (Róbert prišiel — prefixed form). Time expression o koľkej: sentence 8 (O koľkej si prišiel?); o siedmej/o ôsmej: sentences 1, 9, 10. Už/ešte + past tense: sentence 6 (už si doma), sentence 7 (ešte som nešiel), sentence 14 (už bol).

title: Dlhý rad na univerzite
titleEn: A Long Queue at the University

sentences.sk: Róbert prišiel na univerzitu autobusom ráno o ôsmej.
sentences.en: Róbert came to the university by bus at eight in the morning.

sentences.sk: Pred dekanátom stál dlhý rad študentov.
sentences.en: There was a long queue of students in front of the dean's office.

sentences.sk: Marianna už čakala v rade pred Róbertom.
sentences.en: Marianna was already waiting in the queue in front of Róbert.

sentences.sk: Róbert: Prepáč, môžem stáť za tebou?
sentences.en: Róbert: Excuse me, can I stand behind you?

sentences.sk: Marianna: Áno, samozrejme! Prišiel si tiež na zápis?
sentences.en: Marianna: Yes, of course! Did you also come for registration?

sentences.sk: Róbert: Áno, prišiel som vlakom z Bratislavy.
sentences.en: Róbert: Yes, I came by train from Bratislava.

sentences.sk: Marianna: Ja som prišla bicyklom, bývam blízko.
sentences.en: Marianna: I came by bike, I live nearby.

sentences.sk: Rad sa nepohyboval, všetci čakali veľmi dlho.
sentences.en: The queue wasn't moving, everyone waited for a very long time.

sentences.sk: Za Róbertom stálo ešte pätnásť nových študentov.
sentences.en: Behind Róbert there were still fifteen new students standing.

sentences.sk: Marianna: Som hladná. Vidíš tam bufet vedľa vchodu?
sentences.en: Marianna: I'm hungry. Do you see that cafeteria next to the entrance?

sentences.sk: Róbert zostal v rade a Marianna šla do bufetu.
sentences.en: Róbert stayed in the queue and Marianna went to the cafeteria.

sentences.sk: Marianna: Dám si kávu a croissant, prosím.
sentences.en: Marianna: I'll have a coffee and a croissant, please.

sentences.sk: Keď sa Marianna vrátila, rad bol už kratší.
sentences.en: When Marianna returned, the queue was already shorter.

sentences.sk: Konečne prišli na rad a zapísali sa obaja.
sentences.en: They finally reached the front and both registered.

sentences.sk: Róbert a Marianna odišli spolu — noví kamaráti!
sentences.en: Róbert and Marianna left together — new friends!

grammarFocus: Instrumental (bare, transport): 'autobusom' (s.1), 'vlakom' (s.6), 'bicyklom' (s.7); Instrumental with preposition 'za': 'za tebou' (s.4), 'Za Róbertom' (s.9); Restaurant ordering 'Dám si...': (s.12)

title: Fašiangy v dedine

sentences.sk: Carlo a Róbert žili v malej dedine na Slovensku.
sentences.en: Carlo and Róbert lived in a small village in Slovakia.

sentences.sk: Každý rok robili veľký fašiangový večierok.
sentences.en: Every year they held a big carnival party.

sentences.sk: Carlo: Róbert, kde je tvoja maska?
sentences.en: Carlo: Róbert, where is your mask?

sentences.sk: Róbert: Jeho maska bola na poschodí, ale nenašiel ju.
sentences.en: Róbert: His mask was upstairs, but he didn't find it.

sentences.sk: Carlo išiel na poschodí a hľadal masku všade.
sentences.en: Carlo went upstairs and looked for the mask everywhere.

sentences.sk: Našiel malý košík so starými maskami.
sentences.en: He found a small basket with old masks.

sentences.sk: Ich mama pripravila tradičné šišky na stole.
sentences.en: Their mum prepared traditional doughnuts on the table.

sentences.sk: Róbert: Tieto šišky sú veľké a voňajú krásne!
sentences.en: Róbert: These doughnuts are big and smell wonderful!

sentences.sk: Carlo obliekol jeho kostým medveďa.
sentences.en: Carlo put on his bear costume.

sentences.sk: Róbert vzal malý bubon a začal hrať.
sentences.en: Róbert took a small drum and started to play.

sentences.sk: Susedia tancovali na poschodí aj v záhrade.
sentences.en: The neighbours danced upstairs and in the garden too.

sentences.sk: Ich tanec bol veľký a hlučný celú noc.
sentences.en: Their dance was big and noisy all night long.

sentences.sk: Carlo: Fašiangy sú môj obľúbený sviatok!
sentences.en: Carlo: Carnival is my favourite holiday!

sentences.sk: Róbert sa smial a zjedol poslednú šišku.
sentences.en: Róbert laughed and ate the last doughnut.

sentences.sk: Ráno bola dedina tichá, ale ich srdcia boli šťastné.
sentences.en: In the morning the village was quiet, but their hearts were happy.

grammarFocus: Possessive jeho/jej/ich: sentences 4 (jeho maska), 7 (ich mama), 9 (jeho kostým), 12 (ich tanec), 15 (ich srdcia). Locative na poschodí: sentences 4, 5, 11. Adjective veľký/malý: sentences 2 (veľký večierok), 6 (malý košík), 8 (veľké šišky), 10 (malý bubon), 12 (veľký a hlučný), 15 (implied contrast with tichá).

title: Raňajky v kaviarni

sentences.sk: Carlo prišiel do kaviarni o pol deviatej.
sentences.en: Carlo arrived at the café at half past eight.

sentences.sk: Dnes ráno spal len štyri hodiny.
sentences.en: This morning he slept only four hours.

sentences.sk: Čašníčka videla unavenú tvár a usmiali sa.
sentences.en: The waitress saw his tired face and smiled.

sentences.sk: Carlo si sadol a otvoril jedálny lístok.
sentences.en: Carlo sat down and opened the menu.

sentences.sk: O štvrť na desať prišiel aj Róbert.
sentences.en: At quarter to ten Róbert also arrived.

sentences.sk: Carlo: Róbert, kde si bol tak dlho?
sentences.en: Carlo: Róbert, where were you for so long?

sentences.sk: Róbert: Prepáč, stretnúť suseda trvalo veľa času.
sentences.en: Róbert: Sorry, meeting the neighbour took a lot of time.

sentences.sk: Róbert si objednal kávu a vajíčka s chlebom.
sentences.en: Róbert ordered coffee and eggs with bread.

sentences.sk: Carlo objednal veľký čaj a ovsené vločky.
sentences.en: Carlo ordered a large tea and porridge.

sentences.sk: Čašníčka priniesla jedlo rýchlo a pekne ho podala.
sentences.en: The waitress brought the food quickly and served it nicely.

sentences.sk: Róbert videl Carlovu únavu a zasmial sa.
sentences.en: Róbert saw Carlo's tiredness and laughed.

sentences.sk: Róbert: Ty si dnes nespal vôbec, Carlo!
sentences.en: Róbert: You didn't sleep at all today, Carlo!

sentences.sk: Carlo sa najedol a vypil celý čaj.
sentences.en: Carlo ate up and drank all his tea.

sentences.sk: Po raňajkách Carlo stretnúť Róberta každý deň chcel.
sentences.en: After breakfast Carlo wanted to meet Róbert every day.

sentences.sk: Dobrá káva a dobrý priateľ všetko vyriešia.
sentences.en: Good coffee and a good friend solve everything.

grammarFocus: Past tense (-l/-la/-li): prišiel, spal, videla, objednal, priniesla, zasmial, najedol, vypil (sentences 1,2,3,8,9,10,11,13). Present tense (spať/vidieť/stretnúť): 'spal' past of spať (sent.2), 'videla/videl' past of vidieť (sent.3,11), 'stretnúť' infinitive used in sent.7,14. Time expressions: 'pol deviatej' = half past eight (sent.1), 'štvrť na desať' = quarter to ten (sent.5).

title: Prvý deň v posilňovni

sentences.sk: Carlo a Róbert prišli do novej posilňovne.
sentences.en: Carlo and Róbert came to the new gym.

sentences.sk: Carlo: Vidíš toho trénera tam pri recepcii?
sentences.en: Carlo: Do you see that trainer there by the reception?

sentences.sk: Róbert: Áno, volá sa Martin. Je veľmi dobrý.
sentences.en: Róbert: Yes, his name is Martin. He is very good.

sentences.sk: Carlo: Môžeme ho požiadať o pomoc?
sentences.en: Carlo: Can we ask him for help?

sentences.sk: Róbert zavolal trénera Martina k sebe.
sentences.en: Róbert called trainer Martin over to him.

sentences.sk: Martin: Dobrý deň! Čo potrebujete kúpiť?
sentences.en: Martin: Good day! What do you need to buy?

sentences.sk: Carlo: Potrebujeme športové oblečenie a rukavice.
sentences.en: Carlo: We need sports clothing and gloves.

sentences.sk: Martin ukázal im malý obchod vedľa šatne.
sentences.en: Martin showed them the small shop next to the changing room.

sentences.sk: Róbert kúpil nové tenisky a tričko.
sentences.en: Róbert bought new trainers and a t-shirt.

sentences.sk: Carlo: Môžem si vyskúšať aj tento box?
sentences.en: Carlo: Can I also try this boxing?

sentences.sk: Martin: Áno, môžeš! Najprv si oblečieš rukavice.
sentences.en: Martin: Yes, you can! First you will put on the gloves.

sentences.sk: Carlo udrel boxovacie vrece veľmi silno.
sentences.en: Carlo hit the punching bag very hard.

sentences.sk: Róbert sa smial a tlieskol priateľovi Carlovi.
sentences.en: Róbert laughed and clapped for his friend Carlo.

sentences.sk: Carlo: Nemôžem uveriť, že je to tak ťažké!
sentences.en: Carlo: I can't believe it's this hard!

sentences.sk: Obaja chlapci sa dohodli prísť zajtra znova.
sentences.en: Both guys agreed to come again tomorrow.

grammarFocus: Accusative animate masculine -a: 'trénera Martina' (sentence 5 & 2), 'priateľovi Carlovi' uses dative but 'toho trénera' (sentence 2) shows animate masc acc; môcť + infinitive: 'Môžeme ho požiadať' (s4), 'Môžem si vyskúšať' (s10), 'môžeš' + 'Nemôžem uveriť' (s11, s14); shopping vocabulary: 'kúpiť', 'obchod', 'tenisky', 'tričko', 'rukavice', 'oblečenie' (s6–s11)

title: Dva byty

sentences.sk: Zuzana a Maja hľadali nový byt.
sentences.en: Zuzana and Maja were looking for a new apartment.

sentences.sk: Zuzana: Pozri, tento starý byt je veľmi lacný.
sentences.en: Zuzana: Look, this old apartment is very cheap.

sentences.sk: Maja: Ale v starom byte nie je kúpeľňa.
sentences.en: Maja: But in the old apartment there is no bathroom.

sentences.sk: Zuzana: Viem, ale je blízko centra mesta.
sentences.en: Zuzana: I know, but it is close to the city centre.

sentences.sk: Maja nikdy nechcela bývať v takom byte.
sentences.en: Maja never wanted to live in such an apartment.

sentences.sk: Maja: V starom byte som nemohla nič nájsť.
sentences.en: Maja: In the old apartment I could not find anything.

sentences.sk: Potom išli pozrieť moderný byt na Hlavnej ulici.
sentences.en: Then they went to see a modern apartment on Main Street.

sentences.sk: Zuzana: V novom byte je krásna veľká kuchyňa!
sentences.en: Zuzana: In the new apartment there is a beautiful big kitchen!

sentences.sk: Maja: Áno, a v modernom obývačke je veľa svetla.
sentences.en: Maja: Yes, and in the modern living room there is a lot of light.

sentences.sk: Susedka povedala, že tam nikdy nebol hluk.
sentences.en: The neighbour said that there was never any noise there.

sentences.sk: Zuzana: Tu som mohla konečne spať pokojne.
sentences.en: Zuzana: Here I could finally sleep peacefully.

sentences.sk: Maja: Tento byt je drahší, ale oveľa lepší.
sentences.en: Maja: This apartment is more expensive, but much better.

sentences.sk: Zuzana nikam inam ísť nechcela.
sentences.en: Zuzana did not want to go anywhere else.

sentences.sk: Nakoniec si vzali moderný byt spolu.
sentences.en: In the end they took the modern apartment together.

sentences.sk: Maja: V novom krásnom byte sme konečne šťastné!
sentences.en: Maja: In the new beautiful apartment we are finally happy!

grammarFocus: Locative (v + adj + noun): sentences 3 (v starom byte), 6 (v starom byte), 8 (v novom byte), 9 (v modernom obývačke), 15 (v novom krásnom byte). Past tense môcť→mohol/mohla: sentences 6 (nemohla) and 11 (mohla). Double negation: sentence 5 (nikdy nechcela), sentence 6 (nemohla nič), sentence 10 (nikdy nebol), sentence 13 (nikam...nechcela).

title: Zlý autobus

sentences.sk: Johanna a Mišo išli spolu do centra mesta.
sentences.en: Johanna and Mišo went together to the city centre.

sentences.sk: Nastúpili do autobusu číslo deväť.
sentences.en: They got on bus number nine.

sentences.sk: Mišo: Johanna, myslím, že toto nie je správny autobus.
sentences.en: Mišo: Johanna, I think this is not the right bus.

sentences.sk: Johanna: Neboj sa, videla som číslo deväť.
sentences.en: Johanna: Don't worry, I saw number nine.

sentences.sk: Autobus išiel veľmi ďaleko od centra.
sentences.en: The bus went very far from the centre.

sentences.sk: Zastavil v nejakej neznámej štvrti.
sentences.en: It stopped in some unknown neighbourhood.

sentences.sk: Mišo: Sme v nejakej čudnej štvrti, nie v centre!
sentences.en: Mišo: We are in some strange neighbourhood, not in the centre!

sentences.sk: Johanna išla s Mišom von z autobusu.
sentences.en: Johanna went with Mišo out of the bus.

sentences.sk: Stáli na zastávke s jednou starou mapou.
sentences.en: They stood at the stop with one old map.

sentences.sk: Johanna: Mišo, kde sme? Nevidím centrum na mape.
sentences.en: Johanna: Mišo, where are we? I can't see the centre on the map.

sentences.sk: Mišo niesol batoh a hľadal telefón.
sentences.en: Mišo carried a backpack and looked for his phone.

sentences.sk: Našiel správnu zastávku v aplikácii.
sentences.en: He found the correct stop in the app.

sentences.sk: Mišo: Musíme ísť s autobusom číslo štyri späť.
sentences.en: Mišo: We have to go back with bus number four.

sentences.sk: Johanna sa zasmial a povedala: Nabudúce ty vyberáš autobus!
sentences.en: Johanna laughed and said: Next time you choose the bus!

sentences.sk: Konečne prišli do centra, ale o hodinu neskôr.
sentences.en: They finally arrived in the centre, but one hour later.

grammarFocus: Instrumental (s+noun): 'išla s Mišom' (s.8), 'so starou mapou' (s.9), 'autobusom číslo štyri' (s.13); Locative (v+place): 'v centre mesta' (s.1), 'v nejakej neznámej štvrti' (s.6), 'v aplikácii' (s.12); Past tense irregular: 'išli/išla/išiel' (s.1,8,5) from ísť→išiel, 'niesol' (s.11) from niesť→niesol

title: Predané vstupenky

sentences.sk: Mišo a Carlo stáli pri pokladni v kine.
sentences.en: Mišo and Carlo were standing at the ticket booth in the cinema.

sentences.sk: Bol piatok večer a kino bolo plné ľudí.
sentences.en: It was Friday evening and the cinema was full of people.

sentences.sk: Mišo: Chcem dva lístky na prvý film, prosím.
sentences.en: Mišo: I want two tickets for the first film, please.

sentences.sk: Pokladníčka pokrútila hlavou a pozrela na obrazovku.
sentences.en: The cashier shook her head and looked at the screen.

sentences.sk: Pokladníčka: Prepáčte, prvý film je celý vypredaný.
sentences.en: Cashier: Sorry, the first film is completely sold out.

sentences.sk: Carlo: Čo vieme o druhom filme v programe?
sentences.en: Carlo: What do we know about the second film in the programme?

sentences.sk: Pokladníčka: O ňom neviem veľa, je nový.
sentences.en: Cashier: I don't know much about it, it's new.

sentences.sk: Mišo počul o tom filme od kamarátov po škole.
sentences.en: Mišo had heard about that film from friends after school.

sentences.sk: Mišo: Hovorili o ňom, že je veľmi dobrý!
sentences.en: Mišo: They said about it that it's very good!

sentences.sk: Carlo: Dobre, kúpime lístky na druhý film teda.
sentences.en: Carlo: Alright, we'll buy tickets for the second film then.

sentences.sk: Sadli si na tretí rad od plátna v sále.
sentences.en: They sat in the third row from the screen in the hall.

sentences.sk: Pred filmom hovorili o herečkách a o nich samých.
sentences.en: Before the film they talked about the actresses and about them.

sentences.sk: Film začal a obaja hneď zabudli na prvý film.
sentences.en: The film started and both immediately forgot about the first film.

sentences.sk: Po filme Carlo povedal, že to bol najlepší večer.
sentences.en: After the film Carlo said it was the best evening.

sentences.sk: Mišo sa smial a súhlasil pri východe z kina.
sentences.en: Mišo laughed and agreed at the exit from the cinema.

grammarFocus: Locative with 'pri': 'pri pokladni' (s.1), 'pri východe' (s.15); Locative with 'po': 'po škole' (s.8), 'po filme' (s.14); Locative pronouns: 'o ňom' (s.7, s.9), 'o nich' (s.12); Ordinal numbers: 'prvý film' (s.3,s.13), 'druhý film' (s.6,s.10), 'tretí rad' (s.11)

title: Skúška zo slovenčiny

sentences.sk: Johanna a Carlo čakali pred triedou.
sentences.en: Johanna and Carlo were waiting in front of the classroom.

sentences.sk: Carlo: Máš pero? Zabudol som svoje doma.
sentences.en: Carlo: Do you have a pen? I forgot mine at home.

sentences.sk: Johanna: Áno, píš týmto perom, prosím.
sentences.en: Johanna: Yes, write with this pen, please.

sentences.sk: Carlo písal perom veľmi pomaly.
sentences.en: Carlo wrote with the pen very slowly.

sentences.sk: Johanna: Prišiel si dnes so mnou autobusom?
sentences.en: Johanna: Did you come here with me by bus today?

sentences.sk: Carlo: Nie, prišiel som s nimi — so spolužiakmi.
sentences.en: Carlo: No, I came with them — with classmates.

sentences.sk: Učiteľka vošla do triedy so zošitmi.
sentences.en: The teacher entered the classroom with notebooks.

sentences.sk: Carlo: Môžem sedieť so mnou — teda, vedľa teba?
sentences.en: Carlo: Can I sit with you — I mean, next to you?

sentences.sk: Johanna sa zasmala a povedala áno.
sentences.en: Johanna laughed and said yes.

sentences.sk: Učiteľka rozdala testy s ceruzkou v ruke.
sentences.en: The teacher handed out tests with a pencil in her hand.

sentences.sk: Carlo: Mám písať perom alebo ceruzkou?
sentences.en: Carlo: Should I write with a pen or a pencil?

sentences.sk: Učiteľka: Píšte iba perom, prosím.
sentences.en: Teacher: Please write only with a pen.

sentences.sk: Carlo pozrel na Johannu a usmial sa.
sentences.en: Carlo looked at Johanna and smiled.

sentences.sk: Johanna: Vidíš? Moje pero nám pomohlo!
sentences.en: Johanna: You see? My pen helped us!

sentences.sk: Carlo: Zajtra prídem so svojím perom, sľubujem!
sentences.en: Carlo: Tomorrow I will come with my own pen, I promise!

grammarFocus: Instrumental pronoun 'so mnou' (with me) in sentence 5; 's nimi' and 'so spolužiakmi' (with them / with classmates) in sentence 6 — note s/so spelling rule: 'so' used before consonant clusters (so mnou, so spolužiakmi, so zošitmi); instrumental as means/tool: 'perom' (with a pen) in sentences 3, 4, 10, 12; 'ceruzkou' (with a pencil) in sentences 10, 11, 12.

title: Dážď mení plány

sentences.sk: Ráno sa Maja pozrela von oknom.
sentences.en: In the morning Maja looked out the window.

sentences.sk: Videla tmavú oblohu a silný dážď.
sentences.en: She saw a dark sky and heavy rain.

sentences.sk: Maja: Johanna, dnes nemôžeme ísť do parku.
sentences.en: Maja: Johanna, we can't go to the park today.

sentences.sk: Johanna: Prečo nie? Čakala som na ten výlet celý týždeň!
sentences.en: Johanna: Why not? I was waiting for that trip the whole week!

sentences.sk: Maja ukázala na modrú bundu pri dverách.
sentences.en: Maja pointed at the blue jacket by the door.

sentences.sk: Maja: Vidíš ju? Je celá mokrá od včera.
sentences.en: Maja: Do you see it? It's completely wet from yesterday.

sentences.sk: Johanna sa pozrela na bundu a vzdychla.
sentences.en: Johanna looked at the jacket and sighed.

sentences.sk: Johanna: Dobre, zostaneme doma. Čo budeme robiť?
sentences.en: Johanna: Fine, we'll stay home. What will we do?

sentences.sk: Maja mala nápad — upečú spolu čokoládovú tortu.
sentences.en: Maja had an idea — they would bake a chocolate cake together.

sentences.sk: Kúpili múku, vajcia a červenú čokoládu v obchode.
sentences.en: They bought flour, eggs and red chocolate at the shop.

sentences.sk: Johanna ju rýchlo zmiešala v miske.
sentences.en: Johanna mixed it quickly in a bowl.

sentences.sk: Torta voňala skvele a obidve sa smiali.
sentences.en: The cake smelled wonderful and both of them were laughing.

sentences.sk: Prišli aj ich kamarátky — Maja ich pozvala ráno.
sentences.en: Their friends also came — Maja had invited them in the morning.

sentences.sk: Všetky jedli tortu a pili horúci čaj.
sentences.en: They all ate cake and drank hot tea.

sentences.sk: Johanna: Možno je dažďový deň lepší ako výlet!
sentences.en: Johanna: Maybe a rainy day is better than a trip!

grammarFocus: Accusative feminine -u ending: 'tmavú oblohu' (s2), 'modrú bundu' (s5), 'čokoládovú tortu' (s9), 'červenú čokoládu' (s10); Accusative pronouns: 'ju' referring to bundu (s6, s11), 'ich' referring to kamarátky (s13); Colour adjective agreement: 'tmavú oblohu' fem acc (s2), 'modrú bundu' fem acc (s5), 'červenú čokoládu' fem acc (s10)

newWords.en: it smelled / it was fragrant (past tense of voňať)

title: Víkend v horách

sentences.sk: Zuzana a Róbert išli v sobotu do hôr.
sentences.en: Zuzana and Róbert went to the mountains on Saturday.

sentences.sk: Cestovali autobusom, pretože nemali auto.
sentences.en: They travelled by bus, because they didn't have a car.

sentences.sk: Autobus bol plný turistov s veľkými batohmi.
sentences.en: The bus was full of tourists with big backpacks.

sentences.sk: Zuzana: Róbert, vidíš tú vysokú horu pred nami?
sentences.en: Zuzana: Róbert, do you see that tall mountain in front of us?

sentences.sk: Róbert: Áno, dnes tam určite vyjdeme!
sentences.en: Róbert: Yes, we will definitely climb up there today!

sentences.sk: Začali ísť po úzkej ceste hore kopcom.
sentences.en: They started walking along the narrow path up the hill.

sentences.sk: Zuzana šla rýchlo a Róbert bežal za ňou.
sentences.en: Zuzana walked fast and Róbert ran after her.

sentences.sk: Róbert: Počkaj na mňa, som unavený!
sentences.en: Róbert: Wait for me, I am tired!

sentences.sk: Po dvoch hodinách boli obaja na vrchole.
sentences.en: After two hours they were both at the top.

sentences.sk: Výhľad bol krásny – videli celé údolie.
sentences.en: The view was beautiful – they could see the whole valley.

sentences.sk: Potom zišli dole a našli malú horskú reštauráciu.
sentences.en: Then they came down and found a small mountain restaurant.

sentences.sk: Zuzana: Dám si horúcu polievku a chlieb.
sentences.en: Zuzana: I'll have a hot soup and bread.

sentences.sk: Róbert: Ja si dám guláš a veľký čaj.
sentences.en: Róbert: I'll have goulash and a large tea.

sentences.sk: Jedlo bolo výborné a obaja boli šťastní.
sentences.en: The food was excellent and both of them were happy.

sentences.sk: Domov išli vlakom a okamžite zaspali.
sentences.en: They went home by train and fell asleep immediately.

grammarFocus: Bare instrumental (transport): 'autobusom' (sentence 2), 'vlakom' (sentence 15); Instrumental with 'za' (za niekým): 'bežal za ňou' (sentence 7); Restaurant ordering (Dám si...): sentences 12 and 13

title: Pokazená práčka
grammarFocus: reflexive verbs: 'prechádzala sa' (sentence 2), 'tešíme sa' (sentence 14); future perfective: 'stretneme sa' (sentence 13), 'zavolám' (sentence 5); aspect pair: 'kupovať' (sentence 10), 'kúpim' (sentence 15)

sentences.sk: Zuzana ráno otvorila práčku a voda bola všade.
sentences.en: Zuzana opened the washing machine in the morning and water was everywhere.

sentences.sk: Chvíľu sa prechádzala po kuchyni a premýšľala.
sentences.en: She walked around the kitchen for a while and thought.

sentences.sk: Potom zavolala svojej kamarátke Maji.
sentences.en: Then she called her friend Maja.

sentences.sk: Zuzana: Maja, moja práčka je celá pokazená!
sentences.en: Zuzana: Maja, my washing machine is completely broken!

sentences.sk: Maja: Zavolám ti dobrého opravára, dobre?
sentences.en: Maja: I'll call you a good repairman, okay?

sentences.sk: Zuzana: Ďakujem, to by bolo super.
sentences.en: Zuzana: Thank you, that would be great.

sentences.sk: Maja zavolala opravárovi a on prišiel poobede.
sentences.en: Maja called the repairman and he came in the afternoon.

sentences.sk: Opravár pozrel na práčku a pokrútil hlavou.
sentences.en: The repairman looked at the washing machine and shook his head.

sentences.sk: Opravár: Táto práčka je veľmi stará, nedá sa opraviť.
sentences.en: Repairman: This washing machine is very old, it cannot be repaired.

sentences.sk: Zuzana nechcela kupovať novú práčku, bola drahá.
sentences.en: Zuzana did not want to keep buying a new washing machine, it was expensive.

sentences.sk: Maja: Neboj sa, pomôžem ti vybrať dobrú.
sentences.en: Maja: Don't worry, I'll help you choose a good one.

sentences.sk: Zuzana: Dobre, zajtra ideme spolu do obchodu.
sentences.en: Zuzana: Okay, tomorrow we go to the shop together.

sentences.sk: Maja: Áno, stretneme sa pred obchodom o desiatej.
sentences.en: Maja: Yes, we'll meet in front of the shop at ten.

sentences.sk: Zuzana sa tešíme na novú práčku aj na kamarátku.
sentences.en: Zuzana is looking forward to the new washing machine and to her friend.

sentences.sk: Nakoniec kúpim skvelú práčku a všetko bude dobré!
sentences.en: In the end I'll buy a great washing machine and everything will be fine!

title: Skúška zo slovenčiny

sentences.sk: V pondelok ráno mali Marianna a Mišo skúšku.
sentences.en: On Monday morning, Marianna and Mišo had a test.

sentences.sk: Skúška bola na univerzite, v malej učebni.
sentences.en: The test was at the university, in a small classroom.

sentences.sk: Marianna: Mišo, si pripravený na skúšku zo slovenčiny?
sentences.en: Marianna: Mišo, are you ready for the Slovak test?

sentences.sk: Mišo: Nie, včera som veľa pracoval v kancelárii.
sentences.en: Mišo: No, yesterday I worked a lot in the office.

sentences.sk: Marianna: Ja som sa učila celý víkend doma.
sentences.en: Marianna: I studied all weekend at home.

sentences.sk: Profesor Novák sedel za stolom a rozkladal papiere.
sentences.en: Professor Novák sat behind the desk and spread out papers.

sentences.sk: Marianna: Skúška začína prvého februára, teda dnes.
sentences.en: Marianna: The test starts on the first of February, that is today.

sentences.sk: Mišo si sadol na stoličku pri okne v učebni.
sentences.en: Mišo sat down on a chair by the window in the classroom.

sentences.sk: Na skúške boli otázky o práci a o kancelárii.
sentences.en: On the test there were questions about work and about the office.

sentences.sk: Mišo: Ach, tieto slová poznám zo svojej práce!
sentences.en: Mišo: Oh, I know these words from my work!

sentences.sk: Mišo písal rýchlo a odpovedal na všetky otázky.
sentences.en: Mišo wrote quickly and answered all the questions.

sentences.sk: Marianna tiež písala, ale jedna otázka bola ťažká.
sentences.en: Marianna also wrote, but one question was difficult.

sentences.sk: Po skúške stáli obaja na chodbe a čakali.
sentences.en: After the test, both stood in the corridor and waited.

sentences.sk: Profesor Novák prišiel a povedal výsledky v pondelok.
sentences.en: Professor Novák came and announced the results on Monday.

sentences.sk: Marianna dostala jednotku a Mišo tiež — obaja boli šťastní!
sentences.en: Marianna got an A and Mišo too — they were both happy!

grammarFocus: Locative (v/na + place): 'v pondelok ráno' (s.1), 'na univerzite, v malej učebni' (s.2), 'v kancelárii' (s.4), 'na stoličku pri okne v učebni' (s.8), 'na skúške' (s.9), 'na chodbe' (s.13); Dates: 'v pondelok' (s.1, s.14), 'prvého februára' (s.7); Workplace vocabulary: 'kancelária' (s.4, s.9), 'práca' (s.10), 'profesor' (s.6, s.14), 'učebňa' (s.2, s.8)

title: Prekvapenie pre spolubývajúceho

sentences.sk: Róbert a Marianna bývajú spolu v malom byte.
sentences.en: Róbert and Marianna live together in a small apartment.

sentences.sk: Zajtra má ich spolubývajúci Tomáš narodeniny.
sentences.en: Tomorrow their roommate Tomáš has his birthday.

sentences.sk: Marianna: Musíme urobiť prekvapenie pre Tomáša!
sentences.en: Marianna: We must make a surprise for Tomáš!

sentences.sk: Róbert: Áno, musíme kúpiť tortu a balóny.
sentences.en: Róbert: Yes, we must buy a cake and balloons.

sentences.sk: Marianna idem do obchodu pre dekorácie.
sentences.en: Marianna: I'm going to the shop for decorations.

sentences.sk: Róbert: Ja idem do cukrárne pre čokoládovú tortu.
sentences.en: Róbert: I'm going to the cake shop for a chocolate cake.

sentences.sk: Musíme tiež zavolať Tomášových priateľov na párty.
sentences.en: We must also call Tomáš's friends to the party.

sentences.sk: Marianna kúpila farebnú girlandu a balóny pre izbu.
sentences.en: Marianna bought a colourful garland and balloons for the room.

sentences.sk: Róbert niesol tortu domov veľmi opatrne.
sentences.en: Róbert carried the cake home very carefully.

sentences.sk: Musíme schovať všetko pred Tomášom do skrine.
sentences.en: We must hide everything from Tomáš in the wardrobe.

sentences.sk: Tomáš prišiel domov cez otvorené dvere.
sentences.en: Tomáš came home through the open door.

sentences.sk: Všetci kričali: Všetko najlepšie, Tomáš!
sentences.en: Everyone shouted: Happy birthday, Tomáš!

sentences.sk: Tomáš bol veľmi prekvapený a šťastný.
sentences.en: Tomáš was very surprised and happy.

sentences.sk: Spolu jedli tortu a tancovali do noci.
sentences.en: Together they ate cake and danced until night.

sentences.sk: Tomáš: Ďakujem – ste najlepší spolubývajúci na svete!
sentences.en: Tomáš: Thank you – you are the best roommates in the world!

grammarFocus: Accusative after prepositions: 'pre Tomáša' (s.5,7,8), 'do obchodu/cukrárne' (s.5,6), 'na párty' (s.7), 'cez dvere' (s.11), 'do noci/skrine' (s.10,14); modal musieť+infinitive: 'Musíme urobiť' (s.3), 'musíme kúpiť' (s.4), 'Musíme zavolať' (s.7), 'Musíme schovať' (s.10); irregular ísť present: 'idem do obchodu' (s.5), 'idem do cukrárne' (s.6)

title: Nič nesedí!

sentences.sk: Maja a Johanna išli v sobotu nakupovať oblečenie.
sentences.en: Maja and Johanna went shopping for clothes on Saturday.

sentences.sk: Johanna: Koľko je hodín? Obchod sa o deviatej začína.
sentences.en: Johanna: What time is it? The shop opens at nine.

sentences.sk: Maja: Je osem hodín päťdesiat. Poďme rýchlo!
sentences.en: Maja: It is eight fifty. Let's go quickly!

sentences.sk: Johanna niesla veľkú tašku plnú starých šiat.
sentences.en: Johanna carried a big bag full of old clothes.

sentences.sk: V obchode si Maja vzala červené šaty do kabínky.
sentences.en: In the shop, Maja took a red dress into the fitting room.

sentences.sk: Maja: Tieto šaty sú príliš malé. Nesedia mi.
sentences.en: Maja: These dresses are too small. They don't fit me.

sentences.sk: Johanna skúšala modrý sveter, ale bol príliš veľký.
sentences.en: Johanna tried on a blue sweater, but it was too big.

sentences.sk: Johanna: Pred obedom som jedla príliš veľa. To je problém!
sentences.en: Johanna: Before lunch I ate too much. That is the problem!

sentences.sk: Maja sa zasmiali a hľadali ďalšie oblečenie.
sentences.en: Maja laughed and they looked for more clothes.

sentences.sk: Predavačka im priniesla nové veľkosti zo skladu.
sentences.en: The shop assistant brought them new sizes from the stockroom.

sentences.sk: Johanna: Koľko je hodín teraz? Obchod sa o siedmej končí.
sentences.en: Johanna: What time is it now? The shop closes at seven.

sentences.sk: Maja: Je šesť hodín. Máme ešte hodinu!
sentences.en: Maja: It is six o'clock. We still have one hour!

sentences.sk: Nakoniec Maja našla dokonalé zelené nohavice v správnej veľkosti.
sentences.en: Finally Maja found perfect green trousers in the right size.

sentences.sk: Johanna kúpila pekný béžový kabát, ktorý jej skvelo sedel.
sentences.en: Johanna bought a nice beige coat that fit her perfectly.

sentences.sk: Šťastné dievčatá išli domov s plnými taškami.
sentences.en: The happy girls went home with full bags.

grammarFocus: Past tense irregular 'jesť→jedla' in sentence 8 ('jedla príliš veľa'); 'niesť→niesla' in sentence 4 ('niesla veľkú tašku'); reflexive 'začínať sa' in sentence 2 ('obchod sa začína') and 'končiť sa' in sentence 11 ('obchod sa končí'); time expression 'Koľko je hodín?' in sentences 2 and 11.

title: Výlet do hôr

sentences.sk: Marianna a Mišo išli cez víkend do hôr.
sentences.en: Marianna and Mišo went to the mountains over the weekend.

sentences.sk: Mišov batoh bol veľký a ťažký.
sentences.en: Mišo's backpack was big and heavy.

sentences.sk: Mariannin batoh bol malý a ľahký.
sentences.en: Marianna's backpack was small and light.

sentences.sk: Mišo: Cesta je dlhá, ale počasie je krásne.
sentences.en: Mišo: The path is long, but the weather is beautiful.

sentences.sk: Marianna šla vpredu a Mišo šiel vzadu.
sentences.en: Marianna walked in front and Mišo walked behind.

sentences.sk: Marianna: Vpravo je veľký les, pozri!
sentences.en: Marianna: There is a big forest on the right, look!

sentences.sk: Mišo: A vľavo je krásne jazero.
sentences.en: Mišo: And on the left there is a beautiful lake.

sentences.sk: Po hodine bol Mišo unavený.
sentences.en: After an hour Mišo was tired.

sentences.sk: Marianna: Mišo, prečo si taký pomalý?
sentences.en: Marianna: Mišo, why are you so slow?

sentences.sk: Mišo: Mišov batoh je príliš ťažký!
sentences.en: Mišo: Mišo's backpack is too heavy!

sentences.sk: Marianna sa zasmiali a pomohla mu niesť veci.
sentences.en: Marianna laughed and helped him carry things.

sentences.sk: Nakoniec prišli na vrchol hory.
sentences.en: Finally they arrived at the top of the mountain.

sentences.sk: Mariannina fotografia z vrcholu bola nádherná.
sentences.en: Marianna's photo from the top was magnificent.

sentences.sk: Mišo: Výhľad je úžasný, stálo to za to!
sentences.en: Mišo: The view is amazing, it was worth it!

sentences.sk: Sedeli vpredu na skale a jedli sendviče.
sentences.en: They sat at the front on a rock and ate sandwiches.

grammarFocus: Possessive from names (-ov/-ova, -in/-ina): 'Mišov batoh' (sentences 2, 10), 'Mariannin batoh' (sentence 3), 'Mariannina fotografia' (sentence 13). Adjective in predicate: 'bol veľký a ťažký' (sentence 2), 'bol malý a ľahký' (sentence 3), 'počasie je krásne' (sentence 4), 'bol unavený' (sentence 8). Direction words: 'vpredu/vzadu' (sentence 5), 'vpravo' (sentence 6), 'vľavo' (sentence 7), 'vpredu' (sentence 15).

title: Zaujímavý článok

sentences.sk: Carlo čítal noviny v kaviarni.
sentences.en: Carlo was reading a newspaper in a café.

sentences.sk: Róbert si sadol vpravo od Carla.
sentences.en: Róbert sat down to the right of Carlo.

sentences.sk: Carlo: Pozri, tu je Róbertov obľúbený futbalový tím!
sentences.en: Carlo: Look, here is Róbert's favourite football team!

sentences.sk: Róbert: Naozaj? Kde presne?
sentences.en: Róbert: Really? Where exactly?

sentences.sk: Carlo: Článok je vpredu, na prvej strane.
sentences.en: Carlo: The article is at the front, on the first page.

sentences.sk: Róbert vzal noviny a začal čítať.
sentences.en: Róbert took the newspaper and started reading.

sentences.sk: Róbert: Tento článok je veľmi dlhý.
sentences.en: Róbert: This article is very long.

sentences.sk: Carlo: Pokračovanie je vzadu, na poslednej strane.
sentences.en: Carlo: The continuation is at the back, on the last page.

sentences.sk: Róbert rýchlo listoval na poslednú stranu.
sentences.en: Róbert quickly flipped to the last page.

sentences.sk: Róbert: Carlov preklad titulku bol správny!
sentences.en: Róbert: Carlo's translation of the headline was correct!

sentences.sk: Carlo: Som rád, že som pomohol.
sentences.en: Carlo: I am glad that I helped.

sentences.sk: Fotografia hráčov je vľavo od textu.
sentences.en: The photo of the players is to the left of the text.

sentences.sk: Róbert: Tá fotografia je krásna!
sentences.en: Róbert: That photo is beautiful!

sentences.sk: Carlo objednal dve kávy a obaja sa smiali.
sentences.en: Carlo ordered two coffees and they both laughed.

sentences.sk: Ich popoludnie bolo príjemné a bezstarostné.
sentences.en: Their afternoon was pleasant and carefree.

grammarFocus: Possessive from names (-ov/-ova): 'Róbertov obľúbený futbalový tím' (sentence 3), 'Carlov preklad' (sentence 10). Adjective in predicate: 'článok je veľmi dlhý' (sentence 7), 'fotografia je krásna' (sentence 13), 'popoludnie bolo príjemné a bezstarostné' (sentence 15). Direction words: 'vpravo od Carla' (sentence 2), 'vpredu, na prvej strane' (sentence 5), 'vzadu, na poslednej strane' (sentence 8), 'vľavo od textu' (sentence 12).

title: U doktora

sentences.sk: Johanna sa ráno zobudila a cítila sa zle.
sentences.en: Johanna woke up in the morning and felt unwell.

sentences.sk: Mala horúčku a veľmi ju bolelo hrdlo.
sentences.en: She had a fever and her throat hurt a lot.

sentences.sk: Carlo: Johanna, vyzeráš zle. Ideš k doktorovi?
sentences.en: Carlo: Johanna, you look unwell. Are you going to the doctor?

sentences.sk: Johanna: Áno, už som zavolala. Mám termín o desiatej.
sentences.en: Johanna: Yes, I already called. I have an appointment at ten.

sentences.sk: Carlo išiel s Johannou k doktorovi autom.
sentences.en: Carlo went to the doctor with Johanna by car.

sentences.sk: Johanna: O koľkej ordinuje doktor dnes?
sentences.en: Johanna: At what time does the doctor see patients today?

sentences.sk: Carlo: Ordinuje od ôsmej do dvanástej.
sentences.en: Carlo: He sees patients from eight to twelve.

sentences.sk: V čakárni sedelo ešte päť pacientov pred nimi.
sentences.en: In the waiting room there were still five patients before them.

sentences.sk: Johanna ešte nevzala žiadne lieky doma.
sentences.en: Johanna had not yet taken any medicine at home.

sentences.sk: Doktor: Dobrý deň. Čo vás trápi?
sentences.en: Doctor: Good day. What is bothering you?

sentences.sk: Johanna: Bolí ma hrdlo a mám rýmu už tri dni.
sentences.en: Johanna: My throat hurts and I have had a runny nose for three days already.

sentences.sk: Doktor jej prezrel hrdlo a odmerial teplotu.
sentences.en: The doctor examined her throat and measured her temperature.

sentences.sk: Doktor: Máte angínu. Predpíšem vám antibiotiká.
sentences.en: Doctor: You have tonsillitis. I will prescribe you antibiotics.

sentences.sk: Carlo išiel do lekárne a kúpil lieky hneď.
sentences.en: Carlo went to the pharmacy and bought the medicine right away.

sentences.sk: Johanna: Vďaka, Carlo. Už sa cítim trochu lepšie.
sentences.en: Johanna: Thank you, Carlo. I already feel a little better.

grammarFocus: Irregular past tense ísť→išiel: sentences 5 and 14 (Carlo išiel); time expression o koľkej: sentence 6 (O koľkej ordinuje doktor?); už/ešte + past tense: sentence 4 (už som zavolala), sentence 8 (ešte päť pacientov), sentence 9 (ešte nevzala), sentence 15 (už sa cítim lepšie)

title: Raňajky v kaviarni
grammarFocus: pluralia tantum: 'okuliare' (s4), 'nožnice' (s7), 'dvere' (s1); stáť→stojím/stojí (s9,s11); numeral 5+ gen.pl: 'päť croissantov' (s10), 'šesť káv' (s14)

sentences.sk: Johanna a Zuzana vstúpili cez dvere malej kaviarne.
sentences.en: Johanna and Zuzana entered through the door of the small café.

sentences.sk: Johanna: Táto kaviareň je veľmi útulná, páči sa mi tu.
sentences.en: Johanna: This café is very cozy, I like it here.

sentences.sk: Zuzana: Áno, chodím sem každé ráno na raňajky.
sentences.en: Zuzana: Yes, I come here every morning for breakfast.

sentences.sk: Sadli si pri okne a vzali si jedálny lístok.
sentences.en: They sat by the window and took the menu.

sentences.sk: Zuzana: Johanna, čo si dáš? Ja chcem kávu a rožok.
sentences.en: Zuzana: Johanna, what will you have? I want coffee and a roll.

sentences.sk: Johanna hľadala v taške, ale nič nenašla.
sentences.en: Johanna was looking in her bag but found nothing.

sentences.sk: Johanna: Ach nie, zabudla som doma nožnice aj peňaženku!
sentences.en: Johanna: Oh no, I forgot my scissors and wallet at home!

sentences.sk: Zuzana sa zasmia a pozrela na Johannu.
sentences.en: Zuzana laughed and looked at Johanna.

sentences.sk: Zuzana: Nožnice? Prečo stojíš a hľadáš nožnice v kaviarni?
sentences.en: Zuzana: Scissors? Why are you standing and looking for scissors in a café?

sentences.sk: Johanna: Chcela som otvoriť päť vrecúšok cukru naraz!
sentences.en: Johanna: I wanted to open five sugar packets at once!

sentences.sk: Čašníčka pristúpila k stolu a opýtala sa: Čo si prajete?
sentences.en: The waitress approached the table and asked: What would you like?

sentences.sk: Johanna: Prosím si veľkú kávu a croissant.
sentences.en: Johanna: I'd like a large coffee and a croissant.

sentences.sk: Johanna si nasadila okuliare a prečítala cenovník pri pokladni.
sentences.en: Johanna put on her glasses and read the price list at the counter.

sentences.sk: Johanna: Zuzana, tu stojí šesť káv rovnako ako jedna!
sentences.en: Johanna: Zuzana, six coffees cost the same as one here!

sentences.sk: Zuzana: To je nemožné – ale objednajme ich teda všetkých šesť!
sentences.en: Zuzana: That's impossible – but let's order all six of them then!

title: Na pošte
grammarFocus: Locative with 'pri/po' in sentences 1,4,8 (pri okienku, po meste, pri pokladni); locative pronouns 'o nej/o ňom/o nich' in sentences 6,10,13; ordinal numbers in sentences 3,9,14

sentences.sk: Maja stála pri okienku na pošte a čakala.
sentences.en: Maja stood at the counter at the post office and waited.

sentences.sk: Mala veľký balík pre svoju kamarátku Johannu.
sentences.en: She had a big package for her friend Johanna.

sentences.sk: Johanna prišla na poštu druhého januára ráno.
sentences.en: Johanna came to the post office on the second of January in the morning.

sentences.sk: Johanna: Prepáč, hľadala som ťa pri vchode!
sentences.en: Johanna: Sorry, I was looking for you near the entrance!

sentences.sk: Maja: Ja som pri okienku číslo tri.
sentences.en: Maja: I am at counter number three.

sentences.sk: Johanna: Môžeš mi povedať niečo o nej — o tom balíku?
sentences.en: Johanna: Can you tell me something about it — about that package?

sentences.sk: Maja: Je to prekvapenie pre teba, otvor ho doma!
sentences.en: Maja: It is a surprise for you, open it at home!

sentences.sk: Úradníčka hovorila po slovensky pomaly a jasne.
sentences.en: The clerk spoke Slovak slowly and clearly.

sentences.sk: Maja: Prosím si tretí formulár pre medzinárodný balík.
sentences.en: Maja: I would like the third form for an international package.

sentences.sk: Úradníčka: O ňom vám poviem všetko hneď.
sentences.en: Clerk: I will tell you everything about it right now.

sentences.sk: Maja vyplnila formulár a zaplatila pri pokladni.
sentences.en: Maja filled in the form and paid at the cashier.

sentences.sk: Balík bol ťažký, ale Maja sa usmievala.
sentences.en: The package was heavy, but Maja was smiling.

sentences.sk: Johanna: Viem o nej — o tej krabici — niečo!
sentences.en: Johanna: I know something about it — about that box!

sentences.sk: Johanna: Bola si u mňa štvrtého decembra s ňou!
sentences.en: Johanna: You were at my place with it on the fourth of December!

sentences.sk: Maja sa zasmala a povedala: Prekvapenie zrušené!
sentences.en: Maja laughed and said: Surprise cancelled!

title: Košice, konečne!
grammarFocus: past tense irregular ísť→išla (sentences 2, 7, 10); time expression o koľkej (sentences 3, 8); už/ešte + past tense (sentences 5, 6, 9, 13)

sentences.sk: Zuzana a Maja prišli do Košíc v sobotu ráno.
sentences.en: Zuzana and Maja arrived in Košice on Saturday morning.

sentences.sk: Zuzana išla rovno na Hlavnú ulicu.
sentences.en: Zuzana went straight to the Main Street.

sentences.sk: Maja sa spýtala: „O koľkej otvára katedrála?
sentences.en: Maja asked: 'At what time does the cathedral open?'

sentences.sk: Zuzana odpovedala: „Myslím, že o deviatej.
sentences.en: Zuzana answered: 'I think at nine.'

sentences.sk: Maja už videla katedrálu na fotografii.
sentences.en: Maja had already seen the cathedral in a photograph.

sentences.sk: Zuzana ešte nevidela Singing Fountain.
sentences.en: Zuzana had not yet seen the Singing Fountain.

sentences.sk: O desiatej išla Maja do kaviarne na kávu.
sentences.en: At ten o'clock Maja went to a café for coffee.

sentences.sk: Zuzana sa pýtala: „O koľkej ideme na obed?
sentences.en: Zuzana asked: 'At what time are we going for lunch?'

sentences.sk: Maja odpovedala: „Ešte som nejedla nič dnes.
sentences.en: Maja replied: 'I haven't eaten anything yet today.'

sentences.sk: Spolu išli do reštaurácie blízko parku.
sentences.en: Together they went to a restaurant near the park.

sentences.sk: Zjedli halušky a pili domáce víno.
sentences.en: They ate halušky and drank local wine.

sentences.sk: Popoludní našli krásny obchod so suvenírmi.
sentences.en: In the afternoon they found a beautiful souvenir shop.

sentences.sk: Zuzana už kúpila darček pre mamu.
sentences.en: Zuzana had already bought a gift for her mum.

sentences.sk: Večer išli na námestie počúvať hudbu.
sentences.en: In the evening they went to the square to listen to music.

sentences.sk: Maja povedala: „Košice sú úžasné, prídem znova!
sentences.en: Maja said: 'Košice are amazing, I will come again!'

title: Ťažký test
grammarFocus: Adjective opposites: ťažký/ľahký (s3,s8), dlhý/krátky (s6,s11), dobrý/zlý (s13,s15); Locative v+place: v triede (s1), v koridore (s5), v škole (s9); Demonstratives ten/tá/to: tá otázka (s4), ten test (s7), to slovo (s10)

sentences.sk: Marianna a Mišo sedeli v triede na skúške.
sentences.en: Marianna and Mišo were sitting in the classroom at the exam.

sentences.sk: Učiteľka rozdala papiere a povedala: „Začnite!
sentences.en: The teacher handed out papers and said: 'Begin!'

sentences.sk: Marianna: „Mišo, si pripravený?
sentences.en: Marianna: 'Mišo, are you ready?'

sentences.sk: Mišo: „Tá prvá otázka je veľmi ťažká.
sentences.en: Mišo: 'That first question is very difficult.'

sentences.sk: Pred testom čakali dlho v koridore.
sentences.en: Before the test they waited a long time in the corridor.

sentences.sk: Marianna si myslela, že test bude krátky.
sentences.en: Marianna thought that the test would be short.

sentences.sk: Ale ten test mal pätnásť dlhých otázok.
sentences.en: But that test had fifteen long questions.

sentences.sk: Mišo: „Táto gramatika nie je ľahká!
sentences.en: Mišo: 'This grammar is not easy!'

sentences.sk: Marianna sa smeje: „My sme v škole, nie doma!
sentences.en: Marianna laughs: 'We are at school, not at home!'

sentences.sk: Mišo nevedel, čo to slovo znamená.
sentences.en: Mišo did not know what that word meant.

sentences.sk: Odpoveď napísal krátku, len dve slová.
sentences.en: He wrote a short answer, only two words.

sentences.sk: Marianna písala pomaly, ale veľmi starostlivo.
sentences.en: Marianna wrote slowly but very carefully.

sentences.sk: Učiteľka povedala: „Marianna, tvoja odpoveď je dobrá!
sentences.en: The teacher said: 'Marianna, your answer is good!'

sentences.sk: Mišo pozrel na svoju odpoveď a zčervenal.
sentences.en: Mišo looked at his answer and turned red.

sentences.sk: Mišo: „Nabudúce budem mať lepší, nie zlý výsledok!
sentences.en: Mišo: 'Next time I will have a better, not a bad result!'

title: Prechádzka so psom susedky
titleEn: A Walk with the Neighbour's Dog
grammarFocus: Locative with pri/po: sentences 2,5,10,13; locative pronouns o ňom/o nej: sentences 7,11,14; ordinal numbers: sentences 3,9,15

sentences.sk: Maja zazvonila k susedke Johanne po prvý raz.
sentences.en: Maja rang the doorbell at neighbour Johanna's for the first time.

sentences.sk: Johanna stála pri dverách s malým hnedým psom.
sentences.en: Johanna stood by the door with a small brown dog.

sentences.sk: Johanna: Toto je Bruno. Môžeš ho vziať na druhú prechádzku dnes?
sentences.en: Johanna: This is Bruno. Can you take him on the second walk today?

sentences.sk: Maja: Samozrejme! Chodila som po parku aj včera.
sentences.en: Maja: Of course! I walked through the park yesterday too.

sentences.sk: Maja vzala vodítko a išla po dlhej ulici.
sentences.en: Maja took the leash and walked along the long street.

sentences.sk: Bruno bežal rýchlo a Maja ledva stíhala.
sentences.en: Bruno ran fast and Maja could barely keep up.

sentences.sk: Maja myslela na Johannu a hovorila si o nej.
sentences.en: Maja thought about Johanna and said to herself about her.

sentences.sk: Bola veľmi milá a Bruno bol jej najlepší priateľ.
sentences.en: She was very kind and Bruno was her best friend.

sentences.sk: Pri treťom strome Bruno zastal a čuchal trávu.
sentences.en: By the third tree Bruno stopped and sniffed the grass.

sentences.sk: Potom si sadol pri lavičke a oddychoval.
sentences.en: Then he sat down by the bench and rested.

sentences.sk: Maja sa smala a premýšľala o ňom s láskou.
sentences.en: Maja laughed and thought about him with affection.

sentences.sk: Po hodine sa vrátili domov spokojní a unavení.
sentences.en: After an hour they returned home satisfied and tired.

sentences.sk: Johanna čakala pri bráne s teplým čajom.
sentences.en: Johanna waited by the gate with warm tea.

sentences.sk: Johanna: Ako sa ti páčilo? Čo hovoríš o ňom?
sentences.en: Johanna: How did you like it? What do you say about him?

sentences.sk: Maja: Je to najlepší pes! Prídem po štvrtý raz zajtra.
sentences.en: Maja: He is the best dog! I will come for the fourth time tomorrow.

title: Studené ráno
grammarFocus: Possessives (jej auto - sentence 2, jeho bunda - sentence 9, ich problém - sentence 13); Locative (na poschodí - sentence 5); Adjectives veľký/malý (veľký problém - sentence 4, malý skrutkovač - sentence 11)

sentences.sk: Johanna vstala skoro ráno a chcela ísť do práce.
sentences.en: Johanna got up early in the morning and wanted to go to work.

sentences.sk: Jej auto stálo pred domom v silnom mraze.
sentences.en: Her car was standing in front of the house in hard frost.

sentences.sk: Johanna: Dnes je veľmi zima, auto sa nechce zapnúť.
sentences.en: Johanna: It is very cold today, the car does not want to start.

sentences.sk: Toto bol veľký problém pre celé ráno.
sentences.en: This was a big problem for the whole morning.

sentences.sk: Jej suseda Zuzana bývala na poschodí v tom istom dome.
sentences.en: Her neighbour Zuzana lived on the upper floor in the same building.

sentences.sk: Johanna zavolala Zuzanu a povedala jej o probléme.
sentences.en: Johanna called Zuzana and told her about the problem.

sentences.sk: Zuzana: Neboj sa, hneď idem dolu!
sentences.en: Zuzana: Don't worry, I am coming down right away!

sentences.sk: Zuzana prišla rýchlo a pozrela sa na auto.
sentences.en: Zuzana came quickly and looked at the car.

sentences.sk: Zuzana mala so sebou jeho baterku z garáže.
sentences.en: Zuzana had his torch from the garage with her.

sentences.sk: Zuzana: Myslím, že batéria je vybitá.
sentences.en: Zuzana: I think the battery is flat.

sentences.sk: Johanna mala v kufri malý skrutkovač, ale nič viac.
sentences.en: Johanna had a small screwdriver in the boot, but nothing more.

sentences.sk: Zuzana zavolala svojho brata a požičala si káble.
sentences.en: Zuzana called her brother and borrowed jump cables.

sentences.sk: Ich problém bol nakoniec veľmi jednoduchý na riešenie.
sentences.en: Their problem was in the end very simple to solve.

sentences.sk: Brat prišiel, pripojili káble a auto naštartovalo.
sentences.en: Her brother came, they connected the cables and the car started.

sentences.sk: Johanna: Ďakujem, bez teba by som do práce neišla!
sentences.en: Johanna: Thank you, without you I would not have gone to work!

title: Kapela mešká
grammarFocus: Past tense irregulars: jedol (sentence 4), niesol (sentence 7); Time expression Koľko je hodín (sentence 3, 10); Reflexive verbs: začínať sa (sentences 6, 14), končiť sa (sentence 15)

sentences.sk: Róbert a Marianna stáli pred koncertnou sálou.
sentences.en: Róbert and Marianna stood in front of the concert hall.

sentences.sk: Čakali už hodinu a boli netrpezliví.
sentences.en: They had already been waiting for an hour and were impatient.

sentences.sk: Marianna: Koľko je hodín, Róbert?
sentences.en: Marianna: What time is it, Róbert?

sentences.sk: Róbert: Je osem hodín. Jedol som len sendvič.
sentences.en: Róbert: It is eight o'clock. I only ate a sandwich.

sentences.sk: Marianna: Aj ja som hladná. Kde je kapela?
sentences.en: Marianna: I am hungry too. Where is the band?

sentences.sk: Koncert sa mal začínať o siedmej hodine.
sentences.en: The concert was supposed to start at seven o'clock.

sentences.sk: Jeden muž niesol veľké gitarové puzdro na pódium.
sentences.en: One man carried a large guitar case onto the stage.

sentences.sk: Marianna: Konečne! Niekto prišiel!
sentences.en: Marianna: Finally! Someone arrived!

sentences.sk: Róbert: To nie je spevák, len technik.
sentences.en: Róbert: That is not the singer, just a technician.

sentences.sk: Marianna: Koľko je hodín teraz? Už je neskoro!
sentences.en: Marianna: What time is it now? It is already late!

sentences.sk: Róbert: Je pol deviatej. Kapela veľmi mešká.
sentences.en: Róbert: It is half past eight. The band is very late.

sentences.sk: Zrazu sa rozsvietili veľké svetlá na pódiu.
sentences.en: Suddenly the big lights on the stage lit up.

sentences.sk: Spevák vybehol na pódium a ospravedlnil sa publiku.
sentences.en: The singer ran onto the stage and apologised to the audience.

sentences.sk: Koncert sa začal o deviatej hodine večer.
sentences.en: The concert started at nine o'clock in the evening.

sentences.sk: Skončil sa o polnoci a všetci boli šťastní.
sentences.en: It ended at midnight and everyone was happy.

title: Stretnutie na ulici
grammarFocus: Accusative animate masculine (-a ending) in sentences 4, 9, 14; môcť + infinitive in sentences 6, 11, 13; shopping vocabulary throughout sentences 7-13

sentences.sk: Zuzana šla pomaly po ulici s nákupnou taškou.
sentences.en: Zuzana was walking slowly down the street with a shopping bag.

sentences.sk: Zrazu uvidela známu tvár pred obchodom.
sentences.en: Suddenly she saw a familiar face in front of the shop.

sentences.sk: Zuzana: Maja! Ty si tu? Neuveriteľné!
sentences.en: Zuzana: Maja! You are here? Unbelievable!

sentences.sk: Maja: Poznám tohto pekára – robí výborný chlieb!
sentences.en: Maja: I know this baker – he makes excellent bread!

sentences.sk: Zuzana: Ako sa máš? Dlho som ťa nevidela.
sentences.en: Zuzana: How are you? I haven't seen you for a long time.

sentences.sk: Maja: Môžem povedať, že sa mám dobre, ďakujem.
sentences.en: Maja: I can say that I am doing well, thank you.

sentences.sk: Maja: Idem nakupovať – potrebujem mlieko a maslo.
sentences.en: Maja: I am going shopping – I need milk and butter.

sentences.sk: Zuzana: Ja som už kúpila chlieb a zeleninu.
sentences.en: Zuzana: I have already bought bread and vegetables.

sentences.sk: Maja: Videla si môjho brata Petra dnes ráno?
sentences.en: Maja: Did you see my brother Peter this morning?

sentences.sk: Zuzana: Nie, Petra som dnes nevidela vôbec.
sentences.en: Zuzana: No, I did not see Peter at all today.

sentences.sk: Maja: Môže prísť k nám na večeru dnes večer?
sentences.en: Maja: Can he come to us for dinner this evening?

sentences.sk: Zuzana: Neviem, ale mám jeho číslo v telefóne.
sentences.en: Zuzana: I don't know, but I have his number on my phone.

sentences.sk: Zuzana: Môžem mu zavolať teraz, ak chceš.
sentences.en: Zuzana: I can call him now, if you want.

sentences.sk: Maja: Áno, prosím! Zavolaj nášho Petra hneď!
sentences.en: Maja: Yes, please! Call our Peter right away!

sentences.sk: Kamarátky sa zasmiali a spolu vošli do obchodu.
sentences.en: The friends laughed and went into the shop together.

title: Nečakaná návšteva
grammarFocus: pluralia tantum: 'dvere' (sentence 2), 'okuliare' (sentence 8), 'nožnice' (sentence 12); stáť→stojím/stojí (sentences 3, 6); numeral 5+ genitive plural: 'päť minút' (sentence 5), 'šesť rokov' (sentence 10)

sentences.sk: Mišo sedel doma a čítal knihu.
sentences.en: Mišo was sitting at home and reading a book.

sentences.sk: Zrazu niekto zaklopal na dvere.
sentences.en: Suddenly someone knocked on the door.

sentences.sk: Mišo vstal a myslel si: Kto tam stojí?
sentences.en: Mišo got up and thought: Who is standing there?

sentences.sk: Otvoril dvere a nevedel uveriť svojim očiam.
sentences.en: He opened the door and couldn't believe his eyes.

sentences.sk: Carlo: Ahoj, kamarát! Čakal si ma päť minút?
sentences.en: Carlo: Hi, friend! Did you wait for me five minutes?

sentences.sk: Mišo: Carlo! Stojíš tu naozaj pred mojimi dverami!
sentences.en: Mišo: Carlo! You are really standing here in front of my door!

sentences.sk: Carlo: Áno, prišiel som ťa navštíviť!
sentences.en: Carlo: Yes, I came to visit you!

sentences.sk: Mišo: Ale kde máš svoje okuliare?
sentences.en: Mišo: But where are your glasses?

sentences.sk: Carlo: Zabudol som ich doma, som trochu slepý.
sentences.en: Carlo: I forgot them at home, I'm a bit blind.

sentences.sk: Mišo: Nevideli sme sa šesť rokov, priateľ!
sentences.en: Mišo: We haven't seen each other for six years, friend!

sentences.sk: Carlo sa zasmial a objal Miša.
sentences.en: Carlo laughed and hugged Mišo.

sentences.sk: Mišo: Počkaj, nájdem ti nožnice na obal.
sentences.en: Mišo: Wait, I'll find you scissors for the packaging.

sentences.sk: Carlo priniesol tortu zabalenú v darčekovom papieri.
sentences.en: Carlo had brought a cake wrapped in gift paper.

sentences.sk: Carlo: Kúpil som sedem kusov čokolády pre teba!
sentences.en: Carlo: I bought seven pieces of chocolate for you!

sentences.sk: Mišo: Toto je najlepší deň tohto roka!
sentences.en: Mišo: This is the best day of this year!

title: Prvý deň v práci
grammarFocus: Past tense irregulars (jedol s3, niesol s6) in narrative; Koľko je hodín? (s9) for time; reflexive verbs začína sa (s2) and končí sa (s13) for work schedule

sentences.sk: Mišo prišiel do novej kancelárie o ôsmej ráno.
sentences.en: Mišo arrived at the new office at eight in the morning.

sentences.sk: Pracovný deň sa začína presne o ôsmej.
sentences.en: The working day starts exactly at eight.

sentences.sk: Carlo už sedel pri svojom stole a čítal e-maily.
sentences.en: Carlo was already sitting at his desk reading emails.

sentences.sk: Carlo: Ahoj, som Carlo. Vitaj v našom tíme!
sentences.en: Carlo: Hi, I'm Carlo. Welcome to our team!

sentences.sk: Mišo: Ďakujem. Trochu sa bojím, je to môj prvý deň.
sentences.en: Mišo: Thank you. I'm a little nervous, it's my first day.

sentences.sk: Carlo niesol dve šálky kávy zo svojho stola.
sentences.en: Carlo carried two cups of coffee from his desk.

sentences.sk: Carlo: Toto ti pomôže. Káva je vždy dobrý nápad.
sentences.en: Carlo: This will help you. Coffee is always a good idea.

sentences.sk: Mišo jedol raňajky rýchlo doma a bol stále hladný.
sentences.en: Mišo had eaten breakfast quickly at home and was still hungry.

sentences.sk: Mišo: Prepáč, koľko je hodín? Máme prestávku čoskoro?
sentences.en: Mišo: Excuse me, what time is it? Do we have a break soon?

sentences.sk: Carlo: Je desať hodín. Obed je o dvanástej.
sentences.en: Carlo: It's ten o'clock. Lunch is at twelve.

sentences.sk: Mišo sa zasmial a cítil sa trochu lepšie.
sentences.en: Mišo laughed and felt a little better.

sentences.sk: Carlo ukázal Mišovi kanceláriu a predstavil ho kolegom.
sentences.en: Carlo showed Mišo the office and introduced him to the colleagues.

sentences.sk: Pracovný deň sa končí o šesťnástej hodine.
sentences.en: The working day ends at four o'clock.

sentences.sk: Mišo: Tento deň bol dlhý, ale veľmi zaujímavý.
sentences.en: Mišo: This day was long, but very interesting.

sentences.sk: Carlo: Zajtra bude ľahšie. Teraz ideme na pivo!

title: Konferencia v Bratislave

sentences.en: The children sat quietly and listened to the story.

title: Náš deň minútu po minúte
grammarFocus: present byť (sme/ste/sú): sentences 3, 7, 11; accusative direct object: sentences 2, 5, 9, 13; adjective agreement (nationality): sentences 1, 6, 14
