sentences.sk: Johanna: Tvoja červená sukňa a zelený kabát sa hodia!
sentences.en: Johanna: Your red skirt and green coat match!

sentences.sk: Dve kamarátky idú von a všetci sa obzerajú.
sentences.en: The two friends go outside and everyone turns to look.

title: Defekt na ceste do práce
titleEn: A Flat Tire on the Way to Work
grammarFocus: Accusative animate masculine (-a): 'zavolala mechanika', 'vidí kamaráta'; Modal môcť + infinitive: 'môžem ti pomôcť', 'nemôžeme ísť'; Shopping vocabulary: predajňa, kúpiť, zaplatiť, obchod

sentences.sk: Maja a Johanna išli ráno autom do práce.
sentences.en: Maja and Johanna were going to work by car in the morning.

sentences.sk: Zrazu auto začalo divne vibrovať a spomaľovať.
sentences.en: Suddenly the car started vibrating strangely and slowing down.

sentences.sk: Maja: 'Johanna, myslím, že máme defekt!'
sentences.en: Maja: 'Johanna, I think we have a flat tire!'

sentences.sk: Johanna: 'Nie! Nemôžeme ísť ďalej s defektom.'
sentences.en: Johanna: 'No! We can't go any further with a flat tire.'

sentences.sk: Maja zastavila auto pri ceste a vystúpila.
sentences.en: Maja stopped the car by the road and got out.

sentences.sk: Johanna: 'Môžem zavolať mechanika zo servisu.'
sentences.en: Johanna: 'I can call a mechanic from the service station.'

sentences.sk: Maja videla neďaleko malý obchod s autoopravovňou.
sentences.en: Maja saw a small shop with a car repair service nearby.

sentences.sk: Maja: 'Počkaj, vidím tam kamaráta Petra!'
sentences.en: Maja: 'Wait, I can see our friend Peter over there!'

sentences.sk: Johanna zavolala Petra a on rýchlo prišiel.
sentences.en: Johanna called Peter and he came quickly.

sentences.sk: Peter: 'Môžem vám pomôcť vymeniť koleso.'
sentences.en: Peter: 'I can help you change the wheel.'

sentences.sk: V predajni vedľa kúpili nové koleso za dvadsať eur.
sentences.en: In the shop next door they bought a new wheel for twenty euros.

sentences.sk: Johanna zaplatila za koleso kartou pri pokladni.
sentences.en: Johanna paid for the wheel by card at the checkout.

sentences.sk: Peter vymenil staré koleso za nové veľmi rýchlo.
sentences.en: Peter changed the old wheel for the new one very quickly.

sentences.sk: Maja: 'Ďakujeme, Peter! Si skutočný zachránca!'
sentences.en: Maja: 'Thank you, Peter! You are a real lifesaver!'

sentences.sk: Nakoniec prišli do práce len pätnásť minút neskoro.
sentences.en: In the end they arrived at work only fifteen minutes late.

title: Studené ráno
grammarFocus: Nominative plural masc animate (-i/-ia): susedia (s.3), mechanici (s.9), kolegovia (s.12); Numeral 2-4 + nom plural: dvaja susedia (s.3), tri mechanici (s.10), dvaja kolegovia (s.12); Profession vocabulary: mechanik (s.9), šofér (s.7), technik (s.14)

sentences.sk: Ráno bolo veľmi studené a Johanna vyšla z domu.
sentences.en: The morning was very cold and Johanna came out of the house.

sentences.sk: Johanna: Mišo, auto nechce naštartovať!
sentences.en: Johanna: Mišo, the car won't start!

sentences.sk: Dvaja susedia ich počuli a pozreli sa z okna.
sentences.en: Two neighbours heard them and looked out from the window.

sentences.sk: Mišo: Skúšam to už päť minút, nič sa nedeje.
sentences.en: Mišo: I've been trying for five minutes, nothing is happening.

sentences.sk: Johanna: Dnes mám dôležitú prácu o ôsmej ráno.
sentences.en: Johanna: Today I have important work at eight in the morning.

sentences.sk: Mišo otvoril kapotu a pozrel sa na motor.
sentences.en: Mišo opened the hood and looked at the engine.

sentences.sk: Mišo: Ja som len šofér, nie mechanik!
sentences.en: Mišo: I am just a driver, not a mechanic!

sentences.sk: Johanna zavolala do servisu a vysvetlila problém.
sentences.en: Johanna called the service centre and explained the problem.

sentences.sk: Johanna: Prosím, potrebujem mechanikov čo najskôr.
sentences.en: Johanna: Please, I need mechanics as soon as possible.

sentences.sk: Traja mechanici pracovali v tom servise neďaleko.
sentences.en: Three mechanics worked in that service centre nearby.

sentences.sk: Jeden mechanik prišiel za dvadsať minút autom.
sentences.en: One mechanic arrived by car in twenty minutes.

sentences.sk: Dvaja kolegovia mu pomáhali cez telefón.
sentences.en: Two colleagues helped him over the phone.

sentences.sk: Mechanik: Batéria je vybitá, vymeníme ju hneď.
sentences.en: Mechanic: The battery is flat, we will replace it right away.

sentences.sk: Mladý technik rýchlo vymenil starú batériu.
sentences.en: The young technician quickly replaced the old battery.

sentences.sk: Johanna: Auto ide! Ďakujem veľmi pekne!
sentences.en: Johanna: The car works! Thank you very much!

title: Piknik v parku
grammarFocus: Accusative (direct object) in sentences 1,3,6,8,12; chcieť + infinitive in sentences 2,5,10,14; colour + noun in sentences 3,7,9

sentences.sk: Johanna a Mišo išli dnes do parku na piknik.
sentences.en: Johanna and Mišo went to the park today for a picnic.

sentences.sk: Johanna: Chcem jesť sendviče a piť limonádu.
sentences.en: Johanna: I want to eat sandwiches and drink lemonade.

sentences.sk: Mišo vzal veľkú modrú deku a košík s jedlom.
sentences.en: Mišo took a big blue blanket and a basket with food.

sentences.sk: Johanna mala na sebe červenú sukňu a bielu blúzku.
sentences.en: Johanna was wearing a red skirt and a white blouse.

sentences.sk: Mišo: Chcem si oddýchnuť pod týmto stromom.
sentences.en: Mišo: I want to rest under this tree.

sentences.sk: Rozložili deku a otvorili košík.
sentences.en: They spread out the blanket and opened the basket.

sentences.sk: Johanna vybrala žltý tanier a poháriky.
sentences.en: Johanna took out a yellow plate and cups.

sentences.sk: Zrazu Mišo videl na oblohe tmavé mraky.
sentences.en: Suddenly Mišo saw dark clouds in the sky.

sentences.sk: Mišo: Johanna, vidíš tú čiernu mračnu?
sentences.en: Mišo: Johanna, do you see that black cloud?

sentences.sk: Johanna: Nechcem ísť domov, ešte sme nezjedli!
sentences.en: Johanna: I don't want to go home, we haven't eaten yet!

sentences.sk: Ale dážď začal padať veľmi silno.
sentences.en: But the rain started falling very heavily.

sentences.sk: Rýchlo zložili deku a vzali košík.
sentences.en: They quickly folded the blanket and took the basket.

sentences.sk: Johanna: To je katastrofa, som celá mokrá!
sentences.en: Johanna: What a disaster, I am completely wet!

sentences.sk: Mišo: Chcem si dať teplý čaj doma.
sentences.en: Mišo: I want to have warm tea at home.

sentences.sk: Nakoniec jedli sendviče doma a smiali sa.
sentences.en: In the end they ate sandwiches at home and laughed.

title: Skúška zo slovenčiny
grammarFocus: Locative with v/na in sentences 1,4,7,10,13; date expressions in sentences 2,6,12; workplace vocabulary throughout (kancelária, riaditeľ, kolega, úrad)

sentences.sk: Johanna a Carlo pracujú v tej istej kancelárii.
sentences.en: Johanna and Carlo work in the same office.

sentences.sk: V pondelok desiateho marca majú skúšku zo slovenčiny.
sentences.en: On Monday the tenth of March they have a Slovak language test.

sentences.sk: Carlo: Johanna, bojíš sa skúšky?
sentences.en: Carlo: Johanna, are you afraid of the test?

sentences.sk: Johanna: Trochu áno. Učila som sa v čakárni na úrade.
sentences.en: Johanna: A little yes. I studied in the waiting room at the office.

sentences.sk: Carlo: Ja som sa učil doma aj na pracovisku.
sentences.en: Carlo: I studied at home and also at the workplace.

sentences.sk: Prvého marca náš riaditeľ povedal: „Skúška je povinná.
sentences.en: On the first of March our director said: 'The test is mandatory.'

sentences.sk: Johanna stála nervózne pri okne v učebni.
sentences.en: Johanna stood nervously by the window in the classroom.

sentences.sk: Carlo: Neboj sa, sme dobrí kolegovia a pomôžeme si.
sentences.en: Carlo: Don't worry, we are good colleagues and we will help each other.

sentences.sk: Učiteľka rozdala papiere a skúška sa začala.
sentences.en: The teacher handed out papers and the test began.

sentences.sk: Johanna písala odpovede pomaly, ale pozorne na pracovnom stole.
sentences.en: Johanna wrote her answers slowly but carefully at the work desk.

sentences.sk: Carlo: Vedel som všetky otázky o kancelárii a úrade!
sentences.en: Carlo: I knew all the questions about the office and the workplace!

sentences.sk: V piatok siedmeho marca dostali výsledky e-mailom.
sentences.en: On Friday the seventh of March they received the results by email.

sentences.sk: Johanna skočila od radosti v chodbe pri tlačiarni.
sentences.en: Johanna jumped for joy in the hallway by the printer.

sentences.sk: Obaja dostali výborné hodnotenie od riaditeľa firmy.
sentences.en: Both of them received an excellent evaluation from the company director.

sentences.sk: Carlo: Naša slovenčina je teraz lepšia ako káva v bufete!
sentences.en: Carlo: Our Slovak is now better than the coffee in the cafeteria!

title: Konferencia v Bratislave
grammarFocus: Instrumental with 's': sentences 4, 9, 12 (s kolegom, s Róbertom, s novými priateľmi). Locative with 'v': sentences 1, 6, 10 (v Bratislave, v sále, v reštaurácii). Irregular past tense: sentences 3, 7, 11, 14 (išiel→išiel, niesol→niesol, jedol→jedol, mohol→mohol).

sentences.sk: Zuzana prišla na konferenciu v Bratislave v pondelok.
sentences.en: Zuzana arrived at the conference in Bratislava on Monday.

sentences.sk: Bola rada, lebo hovorila po anglicky aj po nemecky.
sentences.en: She was happy because she spoke both English and German.

sentences.sk: Róbert išiel na registráciu s veľkou taškou.
sentences.en: Róbert went to registration with a big bag.

sentences.sk: Zuzana: Dobrý deň, som Zuzana zo Slovenska.
sentences.en: Zuzana: Good day, I am Zuzana from Slovakia.

sentences.sk: Róbert: Ahoj, ja som Róbert z Maďarska. Teší ma.
sentences.en: Róbert: Hi, I am Róbert from Hungary. Nice to meet you.

sentences.sk: Prvá prednáška bola v hlavnej sále hotela.
sentences.en: The first lecture was in the main hall of the hotel.

sentences.sk: Róbert niesol kávu a sedel vedľa Zuzany.
sentences.en: Róbert carried coffee and sat next to Zuzana.

sentences.sk: Zuzana: Páči sa ti táto téma o cestovaní?
sentences.en: Zuzana: Do you like this topic about travelling?

sentences.sk: Róbert: Áno, chodím na konferencie s kolegom každý rok.
sentences.en: Róbert: Yes, I go to conferences with a colleague every year.

sentences.sk: Po prednáške jedli obed v malej reštaurácii.
sentences.en: After the lecture they ate lunch in a small restaurant.

sentences.sk: Róbert jedol polievku a rozprával o svojej práci.
sentences.en: Róbert ate soup and talked about his work.

sentences.sk: Zuzana sa smiala a hovorila s Róbertom veľmi dlho.
sentences.en: Zuzana laughed and talked with Róbert for a very long time.

sentences.sk: Večer išli spolu na recepciu konferencie.
sentences.en: In the evening they went together to the conference reception.

sentences.sk: Zuzana: Dnes som mohol spoznať veľa zaujímavých ľudí!
sentences.en: Zuzana: Today I was able to meet many interesting people!

sentences.sk: Odišli domov s novými priateľmi a šťastnými spomienkami.
sentences.en: They left home with new friends and happy memories.

title: Starý nábytok na predaj
grammarFocus: Reflexive verbs: 'prechádzala sa' (s3), 'tešila sa' (s7), 'stretneme sa' (s11); Future perfective: 'stretneme sa' (s11), 'pozvem' (s13), 'kúpi' (s9); Aspect pair: 'kupovať' imperfective (s6) vs 'kúpiť' perfective (s9, s14)

sentences.sk: Zuzana predávala starý nábytok cez internet.
sentences.en: Zuzana was selling old furniture online.

sentences.sk: Mala krásnu drevenú skriňu a starý stôl.
sentences.en: She had a beautiful wooden wardrobe and an old table.

sentences.sk: Raz popoludní sa Maja prechádzala po meste.
sentences.en: One afternoon Maja was taking a walk around town.

sentences.sk: Maja uvidela Zuzanin inzerát na telefóne.
sentences.en: Maja saw Zuzana's advertisement on her phone.

sentences.sk: Maja: Tá skriňa je naozaj pekná!
sentences.en: Maja: That wardrobe is really nice!

sentences.sk: Chcela kupovať nový nábytok celý mesiac.
sentences.en: She had wanted to buy new furniture for a whole month.

sentences.sk: Maja zavolala Zuzane a spýtala sa na cenu.
sentences.en: Maja called Zuzana and asked about the price.

sentences.sk: Zuzana: Skriňa stojí päťdesiat eur, stôl tridsať.
sentences.en: Zuzana: The wardrobe costs fifty euros, the table thirty.

sentences.sk: Maja: Dobre, chcem kúpiť obe veci!
sentences.en: Maja: Okay, I want to buy both things!

sentences.sk: Zuzana sa tešila, lebo potrebovala peniaze.
sentences.en: Zuzana was happy because she needed the money.

sentences.sk: Zuzana: Stretneme sa zajtra ráno u mňa.
sentences.en: Zuzana: We will meet tomorrow morning at my place.

sentences.sk: Maja prišla ráno s veľkým autom.
sentences.en: Maja came in the morning with a big car.

sentences.sk: Zuzana: Pozvem ťa na kávu pred odchodom.
sentences.en: Zuzana: I will invite you for coffee before you leave.

sentences.sk: Maja kúpila skriňu aj stôl za dobrú cenu.
sentences.en: Maja bought the wardrobe and the table for a good price.

sentences.sk: Obe ženy odišli domov veľmi spokojné.
sentences.en: Both women went home very satisfied.

title: Dáždivý deň
grammarFocus: Instrumental (bare, transport): sentences 3, 7 — 'išli autobusom', 'prišli taxíkom'; Instrumental with 'za': sentence 10 — 'bežal za Johannou'; Restaurant ordering with 'Dám si': sentences 12, 13

sentences.sk: Ráno svietilo slnko a Johanna plánovala piknik.
sentences.en: In the morning the sun was shining and Johanna planned a picnic.

sentences.sk: Zrazu sa obloha zatemnila a začalo pršať.
sentences.en: Suddenly the sky darkened and it began to rain.

sentences.sk: Carlo: Johanna, nemôžeme ísť von. Poďme autobusom do mesta.
sentences.en: Carlo: Johanna, we can't go outside. Let's go by bus to town.

sentences.sk: Johanna: Dobre, ale nemám dáždnik.
sentences.en: Johanna: Fine, but I don't have an umbrella.

sentences.sk: Carlo vzal svoj starý dáždnik a otvoril dvere.
sentences.en: Carlo took his old umbrella and opened the door.

sentences.sk: Vonku pršalo veľmi silno a vietor bol studený.
sentences.en: Outside it was raining very hard and the wind was cold.

sentences.sk: Nakoniec prišli taxíkom pred malú reštauráciu.
sentences.en: In the end they arrived by taxi in front of a small restaurant.

sentences.sk: Reštaurácia bola teplá a voňala dobre.
sentences.en: The restaurant was warm and smelled nice.

sentences.sk: Čašník ich posadil pri okne.
sentences.en: The waiter seated them by the window.

sentences.sk: Carlo zabudol peňaženku a bežal za Johannou po ulici.
sentences.en: Carlo forgot his wallet and ran after Johanna along the street.

sentences.sk: Johanna sa zasmala a vrátila sa k nemu.
sentences.en: Johanna laughed and went back to him.

sentences.sk: Johanna: Dám si polievku a horúci čaj, prosím.
sentences.en: Johanna: I'll have soup and hot tea, please.

sentences.sk: Carlo: Dám si cestoviny a pohár červeného vína.
sentences.en: Carlo: I'll have pasta and a glass of red wine.

sentences.sk: Za oknom stále pršalo, ale im bolo dobre.
sentences.en: Outside the window it was still raining, but they felt good.

sentences.sk: Johanna: Možno bol dáždivý deň lepší nápad ako piknik.
sentences.en: Johanna: Maybe the rainy day was a better idea than a picnic.

title: Meniny s tortou
grammarFocus: Accusative feminine -u ending: tortу, Zuzanu, darčeku, červenú, bielu (sentences 1,3,5,8,10); Accusative pronouns ho/ju/ich: ju (s.4,6,11), ho (s.9,13), ich (s.15); Colour adjective agreement: červenú krabicu (s.5), bielu tortu (s.8), zelený darček (s.12)

sentences.sk: Dnes má Zuzana meniny a je veľmi šťastná.
sentences.en: Today is Zuzana's name day and she is very happy.

sentences.sk: Johanna: Zuzana, mám pre teba prekvapenie!
sentences.en: Johanna: Zuzana, I have a surprise for you!

sentences.sk: Zuzana nevidí Johannu, lebo ona sa schováva.
sentences.en: Zuzana cannot see Johanna, because she is hiding.

sentences.sk: Johanna: Hľadáš ju? Ja som tu, v kuchyni!
sentences.en: Johanna: Are you looking for her? I am here, in the kitchen!

sentences.sk: Johanna drží červenú krabicu v rukách.
sentences.en: Johanna is holding a red box in her hands.

sentences.sk: Zuzana: Čo je to? Môžem ju otvoriť?
sentences.en: Zuzana: What is that? Can I open it?

sentences.sk: Johanna: Áno, otvor ju pomaly!
sentences.en: Johanna: Yes, open it slowly!

sentences.sk: V krabici je krásna bielu tortu so sviečkami.
sentences.en: In the box there is a beautiful white cake with candles.

sentences.sk: Zuzana: Ty si ho upiekla sama? Ďakujem ti!
sentences.en: Zuzana: You baked it yourself? Thank you!

sentences.sk: Johanna dáva Zuzane aj malú modrú tašku.
sentences.en: Johanna also gives Zuzana a small blue bag.

sentences.sk: Zuzana ju otvára a vidí zelený šál vnútri.
sentences.en: Zuzana opens it and sees a green scarf inside.

sentences.sk: Zuzana: Zelený darček sa mi páči najviac!
sentences.en: Zuzana: I like the green gift the most!

sentences.sk: Johanna zapáli sviečky a Zuzana ho sfúkne.
sentences.en: Johanna lights the candles and Zuzana blows it out.

sentences.sk: Obe jedia tortu a smejú sa spolu.
sentences.en: Both of them eat cake and laugh together.

sentences.sk: Johanna: Nabudúce zavolám aj kamarátky – oslávime ich!
sentences.en: Johanna: Next time I will call the friends too – we will celebrate them!

title: Búrka bez svetla
grammarFocus: Instrumental (bare, transport): sentence 3 'autobusom'; instrumental with preposition 'za': sentence 8 'za Majou'; restaurant ordering 'Dám si': sentence 12

sentences.sk: Vonku bola silná búrka a pršalo celý deň.
sentences.en: Outside there was a strong storm and it rained all day.

sentences.sk: Maja a Johanna sedeli doma a čítali knihy.
sentences.en: Maja and Johanna were sitting at home and reading books.

sentences.sk: Johanna: Prišla som dnes autobusom, lebo moje auto je rozbité.
sentences.en: Johanna: I came today by bus, because my car is broken.

sentences.sk: Maja: To je smola. Chceš čaj alebo kávu?
sentences.en: Maja: That's bad luck. Do you want tea or coffee?

sentences.sk: Zrazu svetlo zhaslo a izba bola úplne tmavá.
sentences.en: Suddenly the light went out and the room was completely dark.

sentences.sk: Maja: Prepáč, nemám doma žiadne sviečky!
sentences.en: Maja: Sorry, I don't have any candles at home!

sentences.sk: Johanna vstala a opatrne hľadala telefón na stole.
sentences.en: Johanna got up and carefully looked for her phone on the table.

sentences.sk: Maja šla pomaly za Johannou do kuchyne.
sentences.en: Maja walked slowly behind Johanna into the kitchen.

sentences.sk: Johanna: Nájdeme reštauráciu a počkáme tam na opravu.
sentences.en: Johanna: We'll find a restaurant and wait there for the repair.

sentences.sk: Vonku stále pršalo, ale kamarátky vzali dáždniky a vyšli.
sentences.en: Outside it was still raining, but the friends took umbrellas and went out.

sentences.sk: Našli malú útulnú reštauráciu hneď za rohom.
sentences.en: They found a small cosy restaurant just around the corner.

sentences.sk: Johanna: Dám si horúcu polievku, prosím.
sentences.en: Johanna: I'll have a hot soup, please.

sentences.sk: Maja: Ja si dám cestoviny so syrom, ďakujem.
sentences.en: Maja: I'll have pasta with cheese, thank you.

sentences.sk: Jedlo bolo výborné a búrka pomaly utíchla.
sentences.en: The food was excellent and the storm slowly died down.

sentences.sk: Keď sa vrátili domov, svetlo už svietilo.
sentences.en: When they came back home, the light was already on.

newWords.en: to go out / switch off (of light)

title: Pokazená práčka
grammarFocus: present byť (som/si/je) in sentences 1,3,7,10; nationality/country vocabulary in sentences 7,8,9; question Odkiaľ ste?/Kde bývate? in sentences 8,9

sentences.sk: Maja stojí v kuchyni a pozerá na práčku.
sentences.en: Maja stands in the kitchen and looks at the washing machine.

sentences.sk: Práčka je celá mokrá a nefunguje.
sentences.en: The washing machine is completely wet and not working.

sentences.sk: Maja hovorí: "To je katastrofa! Čo teraz?"
sentences.en: Maja says: "This is a disaster! What now?"

sentences.sk: Johanna: "Zavolaj opravára, rýchlo!"
sentences.en: Johanna: "Call the repairman, quickly!"

sentences.sk: Maja volá opravára a hovorí: "Práčka nefunguje."
sentences.en: Maja calls the repairman and says: "The washing machine is not working."

sentences.sk: Opravár príde o hodinu.
sentences.en: The repairman arrives in an hour.

sentences.sk: Opravár: "Dobrý deň, som Peter Novák."
sentences.en: Repairman: "Hello, I am Peter Novák."

sentences.sk: Maja: "Odkiaľ ste, pán Novák?"
sentences.en: Maja: "Where are you from, Mr. Novák?"

sentences.sk: Peter: "Som zo Slovenska, z Trenčína. Kde bývate vy?"
sentences.en: Peter: "I am from Slovakia, from Trenčín. Where do you live?"

sentences.sk: Johanna: "My sme z Nemecka, ale bývame tu."
sentences.en: Johanna: "We are from Germany, but we live here."

sentences.sk: Peter pozerá na práčku a hovorí: "Aha, vidím problém."
sentences.en: Peter looks at the washing machine and says: "Ah, I see the problem."

sentences.sk: Peter: "Hadica je pokazená."
sentences.en: Peter: "The hose is broken."

sentences.sk: Peter vymení hadicu za dvadsať minút.
sentences.en: Peter replaces the hose in twenty minutes.

sentences.sk: Maja: "Ďakujeme veľmi pekne, ste šikovný!"
sentences.en: Maja: "Thank you very much, you are skilful!"

sentences.sk: Johanna zapne práčku a obidve sa smejú.
sentences.en: Johanna turns on the washing machine and both of them laugh.

title: Prvý deň v posilňovni
grammarFocus: Instrumental pronoun 'so mnou' (sentence 3), 's ňou' (sentence 9), 's nimi' (sentence 13); s/so spelling rule: 'so mnou' (before m-cluster), 's Carlom' (before C); instrumental of means: 'činkou' (sentence 7), 'loptou' (sentence 11)

sentences.sk: Johanna prišla do posilňovne prvýkrát v živote.
sentences.en: Johanna came to the gym for the first time in her life.

sentences.sk: Carlo už cvičil pri veľkých činkách.
sentences.en: Carlo was already working out by the big weights.

sentences.sk: Carlo: Johanna, poď cvičiť so mnou!
sentences.en: Carlo: Johanna, come work out with me!

sentences.sk: Johanna: Dobre, ale neviem, čo mám robiť.
sentences.en: Johanna: Okay, but I don't know what I should do.

sentences.sk: Carlo vzal loptu a ukázal jej nové cvičenie.
sentences.en: Carlo took a ball and showed her a new exercise.

sentences.sk: Johanna: Chcem skúsiť tenis. Je tu raketa?
sentences.en: Johanna: I want to try tennis. Is there a racket here?

sentences.sk: Carlo: Áno, môžeš trénovať s touto činkou najprv.
sentences.en: Carlo: Yes, you can train with this dumbbell first.

sentences.sk: Johanna zdvihla činku pravou rukou pomaly.
sentences.en: Johanna lifted the dumbbell with her right hand slowly.

sentences.sk: Tréner prišiel a chcel cvičiť s ňou.
sentences.en: The trainer came and wanted to work out with her.

sentences.sk: Tréner: Držte raketu pevne oboma rukami!
sentences.en: Trainer: Hold the racket firmly with both hands!

sentences.sk: Johanna hádzala loptu o stenu znova a znova.
sentences.en: Johanna threw the ball against the wall again and again.

sentences.sk: Carlo sa smial, lebo loptou rozbila vázu.
sentences.en: Carlo laughed because she broke a vase with the ball.

sentences.sk: Johanna: Necvičte viac s nimi bez ochrannej siete!
sentences.en: Johanna: Don't work out with them without a safety net anymore!

sentences.sk: Tréner si zapísal poznámku perom do zošita.
sentences.en: The trainer wrote a note with a pen in his notebook.

sentences.sk: Carlo a Johanna sa dohodli prísť znova zajtra.
sentences.en: Carlo and Johanna agreed to come again tomorrow.

title: Na párty
grammarFocus: Accusative after 'na' (sentences 1,3,8,13); musieť (sentences 11,14); time expression 'o koľkej' (sentence 10,14)

sentences.sk: Carlo prišiel na párty v sobotu večer.
sentences.en: Carlo arrived at the party on Saturday evening.

sentences.sk: Nepoznal tam nikoho a bol trochu nervózny.
sentences.en: He didn't know anyone there and was a little nervous.

sentences.sk: Pozrel sa na mladého muža pri okne.
sentences.en: He looked at a young man by the window.

sentences.sk: Carlo: Dobrý večer! Volám sa Carlo.
sentences.en: Carlo: Good evening! My name is Carlo.

sentences.sk: Róbert: Ahoj, Carlo! Ja som Róbert.
sentences.en: Róbert: Hello, Carlo! I am Róbert.

sentences.sk: Carlo: Si Slovák? Odkiaľ si?
sentences.en: Carlo: Are you Slovak? Where are you from?

sentences.sk: Róbert: Áno, som zo Slovenska. A ty?
sentences.en: Róbert: Yes, I am from Slovakia. And you?

sentences.sk: Carlo: Ja som Talian. Cestujem na konferenciu.
sentences.en: Carlo: I am Italian. I am travelling to a conference.

sentences.sk: Róbert: Hovoríš po slovensky veľmi dobre!
sentences.en: Róbert: You speak Slovak very well!

sentences.sk: Carlo: Ďakujem! O koľkej začína párty program?
sentences.en: Carlo: Thank you! At what time does the party programme start?

sentences.sk: Róbert: Musíme sa opýtať hostitela, neviem presne.
sentences.en: Róbert: We must ask the host, I don't know exactly.

sentences.sk: Našli hostitela a opýtali sa ho.
sentences.en: They found the host and asked him.

sentences.sk: Hostiteľ: Program začína na pol deviatej.
sentences.en: Host: The programme starts at half past eight.

sentences.sk: Carlo: Och, musím ísť domov o desiatej!
sentences.en: Carlo: Oh, I must go home at ten!

sentences.sk: Róbert sa zasmial a povedal: „Tak si daj aspoň jeden drink!
sentences.en: Róbert laughed and said: 'Then at least have one drink!'

title: Na trhu
grammarFocus: Accusative after 'na' (sentences 1,4,8,12); musieť modal (sentences 3,10,14); time expression 'o koľkej' (sentences 6,13)

sentences.sk: Johanna a Carlo prišli na trh skoro ráno.
sentences.en: Johanna and Carlo came to the market early in the morning.

sentences.sk: Na stánku ležalo veľa čerstvého ovocia.
sentences.en: At the stall there was a lot of fresh fruit.

sentences.sk: Carlo: Musím kúpiť jahody pre mamu.
sentences.en: Carlo: I must buy strawberries for mum.

sentences.sk: Johanna: Pozri sa na tie maliny, sú krásne!
sentences.en: Johanna: Look at those raspberries, they are beautiful!

sentences.sk: Predavač: Kilogram jahôd stojí päť eur.
sentences.en: Vendor: A kilogram of strawberries costs five euros.

sentences.sk: Carlo: O koľkej zatvárate dnes stánok?
sentences.en: Carlo: At what time do you close the stall today?

sentences.sk: Predavač: Zatvárame o dvanástej hodine.
sentences.en: Vendor: We close at twelve o'clock.

sentences.sk: Carlo: Dáme si pohľad na tie veľké jahody.
sentences.en: Carlo: Let us have a look at those big strawberries.

sentences.sk: Johanna: Päť eur je veľa, skúsme zjednať cenu.
sentences.en: Johanna: Five euros is a lot, let us try to haggle.

sentences.sk: Carlo: Musíme dostať lepšiu cenu, prosím.
sentences.en: Carlo: We must get a better price, please.

sentences.sk: Predavač: Dobre, dám vám kilogram za štyri eurá.
sentences.en: Vendor: Fine, I will give you a kilogram for four euros.

sentences.sk: Johanna: Super! Vezmeme aj maliny na koláč.
sentences.en: Johanna: Great! We will also take raspberries for a cake.

sentences.sk: Carlo: O koľkej začíname piecť koláč doma?
sentences.en: Carlo: At what time do we start baking the cake at home?

sentences.sk: Johanna: Musíme začať o druhej hodine popoludní.
sentences.en: Johanna: We must start at two o'clock in the afternoon.

sentences.sk: Zaplatili a odišli domov veselí a spokojní.
sentences.en: They paid and went home happy and satisfied.

title: Starý gauč hľadá nový domov
titleEn: The Old Couch Seeks a New Home
grammarFocus: Reflexive verbs in present: 'volá sa' (s3), 'pýta sa' (s5), 'učí sa' (s9); past tense reflexive: 'stalo sa' (s2), 'stretli sa' (s12); word order with sa: sa appears after verb in main clause (s3,s5,s9), after subject+verb in s2,s12

sentences.sk: Róbert mal doma starý gauč a dve stoličky.
sentences.en: Róbert had an old couch and two chairs at home.

sentences.sk: Stalo sa, že potreboval rýchlo miesto v byte.
sentences.en: It happened that he quickly needed space in the flat.

sentences.sk: Nafotil nábytok a dal inzerát na internet.
sentences.en: He photographed the furniture and posted an ad on the internet.

sentences.sk: Inzerát sa volal: Gauč zadarmo, iba odvoz.
sentences.en: The ad was called: Couch for free, just pick it up.

sentences.sk: Marianna sa pýtala: Je gauč ešte voľný?
sentences.en: Marianna asked: Is the couch still available?

sentences.sk: Róbert: Áno, môžete si ho pozrieť dnes.
sentences.en: Róbert: Yes, you can come and look at it today.

sentences.sk: Marianna: Perfektné, o tri hodiny som tam.
sentences.en: Marianna: Perfect, I will be there at three o'clock.

sentences.sk: Róbert upratoval byt a čakal pri dverách.
sentences.en: Róbert tidied the flat and waited by the door.

sentences.sk: Marianna sa učí zariaďovať byt bez veľkých výdavkov.
sentences.en: Marianna is learning to furnish a flat without big expenses.

sentences.sk: Marianna: Tento gauč je presne to, čo chcem!
sentences.en: Marianna: This couch is exactly what I want!

sentences.sk: Spoločne vyniesli ťažký gauč po schodoch dolu.
sentences.en: Together they carried the heavy couch down the stairs.

sentences.sk: Stretli sa ešte raz pri aute na ulici.
sentences.en: They met once more by the car on the street.

sentences.sk: Marianna zaplatila Róbertovi za stoličky dvadsať eur.
sentences.en: Marianna paid Róbert twenty euros for the chairs.

sentences.sk: Róbert: Teraz mám v byte konečne dosť miesta!
sentences.en: Róbert: Now I finally have enough space in the flat!

sentences.sk: Obaja odišli spokojní a Marianna sa usmiala.
sentences.en: Both left satisfied and Marianna smiled.

title: Víkend v Košiciach
grammarFocus: Locative with 'o' (sentences 3, 9, 13); double negation with 'nikto/nič ne-' (sentences 6, 11, 14); weekday + time expressions (sentences 1, 5, 12)

sentences.sk: V piatok večer Johanna a Mišo prišli do Košíc.
sentences.en: On Friday evening Johanna and Mišo arrived in Košice.

sentences.sk: Johanna: Toto mesto je také krásne a živé!
sentences.en: Johanna: This city is so beautiful and lively!

sentences.sk: Mišo: Počul som veľa o Starom meste.
sentences.en: Mišo: I heard a lot about the Old Town.

sentences.sk: Šli spolu na hlavnú ulicu hneď po príchode.
sentences.en: They went together to the main street right after arriving.

sentences.sk: V sobotu ráno vstali skoro a šli na Dóm.
sentences.en: On Saturday morning they got up early and went to the Cathedral.

sentences.sk: Pred Dómom nikto nebol – mali ho len pre seba.
sentences.en: In front of the Cathedral nobody was there – they had it all to themselves.

sentences.sk: Johanna: Toto je najväčší kostol, aký som videla!
sentences.en: Johanna: This is the biggest church I have ever seen!

sentences.sk: Mišo odfotil Johannu pred hlavným vchodom.
sentences.en: Mišo took a photo of Johanna in front of the main entrance.

sentences.sk: Potom hovorili o histórii mesta pri káve.
sentences.en: Then they talked about the history of the city over coffee.

sentences.sk: Johanna: Chcem nájsť tradičnú košickú reštauráciu.
sentences.en: Johanna: I want to find a traditional Košice restaurant.

sentences.sk: Mišo hľadal reštauráciu, ale nič nenašiel na mape.
sentences.en: Mišo was looking for a restaurant but found nothing on the map.

sentences.sk: V nedeľu poobede našli malú krčmu blízko parku.
sentences.en: On Sunday afternoon they found a small tavern near the park.

sentences.sk: Čašník im povedal všetko o špeciálnom menu dňa.
sentences.en: The waiter told them everything about the special menu of the day.

sentences.sk: Johanna nezjedla nič zlé – halušky boli úžasné!
sentences.en: Johanna ate nothing bad – the dumplings were amazing!

sentences.sk: Mišo: Košice nás určite ešte raz uvidia!
sentences.en: Mišo: Košice will surely see us again!

title: Narodeninovú oslavu pre Martina
grammarFocus: Reflexive verbs in present: 'volá sa' (s3), 'učí sa' (s4), 'pýta sa' (s7); past tense reflexive: 'stretol sa' (s2), 'stalo sa' (s11); word order with sa: 'sa pýta' after adverb (s7), 'sa mu' cluster (s14)

sentences.sk: Carlo a Róbert sú spolubývajúci v malom byte.
sentences.en: Carlo and Róbert are roommates in a small apartment.

sentences.sk: Včera sa Carlo stretol s Martinom v kaviarni.
sentences.en: Yesterday Carlo met Martin at the café.

sentences.sk: Martin má budúci týždeň narodeniny.
sentences.en: Martin has his birthday next week.

sentences.sk: Carlo: Róbert, ako sa volá Martinova obľúbená kapela?
sentences.en: Carlo: Róbert, what is Martin's favourite band called?

sentences.sk: Róbert: Myslím, že sa volajú Hex.
sentences.en: Róbert: I think they are called Hex.

sentences.sk: Carlo: Skvelé! Chceme urobiť veľkú oslavu doma.
sentences.en: Carlo: Great! We want to throw a big party at home.

sentences.sk: Róbert sa pýta, koľko ľudí pozveme.
sentences.en: Róbert asks how many people we will invite.

sentences.sk: Carlo: Pozval som desať priateľov na sobotu večer.
sentences.en: Carlo: I invited ten friends for Saturday evening.

sentences.sk: Róbert kúpil tortu a balóny v obchode.
sentences.en: Róbert bought a cake and balloons at the shop.

sentences.sk: Carlo ozdobil obývačku farebnými girlandami.
sentences.en: Carlo decorated the living room with colourful garlands.

sentences.sk: Zrazu sa stalo niečo vtipné pri dverách.
sentences.en: Suddenly something funny happened at the door.

sentences.sk: Martin prišiel domov skôr ako zvyčajne.
sentences.en: Martin came home earlier than usual.

sentences.sk: Carlo: Rýchlo skry tortu za pohovku!
sentences.en: Carlo: Quick, hide the cake behind the sofa!

sentences.sk: Róbert sa mu zachichotal a zhasol svetlo.
sentences.en: Róbert chuckled at him and turned off the light.

sentences.sk: Martin otvoril dvere a všetci kričali: Prekvapenie!
sentences.en: Martin opened the door and everyone shouted: Surprise!
